raw.title: Developer Relations Manager – Data Processing and Databases
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA is building GPU acceleration for the analytical data processing ecosystem: the query engines, data platforms, and processing frameworks that the world runs its analytics on.
raw.description:
NVIDIA is building GPU acceleration for the analytical data processing ecosystem: the query engines, data platforms, and processing frameworks that the world runs its analytics on. Making that real means embedding an acceleration layer inside engines we do not own. Each of those engines has its own optimizer, scheduler, memory model, and exchange, and each one draws the line between "adopt your component" and "keep mine" in a different place. Nobody has settled what that integration surface should look like. That is the problem this role owns. We are looking for someone with genuine depth in how analytical data systems are built: query planning and processing, columnar and vectorized processing, storage formats, or the internals of a SQL engine.

You will work with the maintainers, architects, and engineering leaders behind these systems, in public where the project is open and directly where it is not, on how acceleration lands in what they ship. You will produce the benchmark evidence that shows whether it worked, and turn what you learn into concrete requirements for NVIDIA's roadmap. This is a developer relations role rather than an engineering role because the leverage is breadth. An engineer improves one engine. This role shapes how acceleration lands across the ecosystem and influences which parts of it get there first.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build and deepen technical expertise in analytical data processing, including query execution and optimization, columnar and vectorized processing, and distributed execution. Serve as a technical advocate and trusted resource for the developers building and operating these systems, working with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies such as Sirius, cuCascade, RAPIDS, cuDF, nvCOMP, and CUDA-X Data Processing.

  • Demonstrate and integrate NVIDIA's data processing stack (libraries, SDKs, and tools) into real query engines and OLAP databases, carrying the work from prototype through to a functioning, measured integration across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.

  • Support developers, projects, and partners through onboarding and integration by providing working reference implementations, integration guides, and direct hands-on engineering help, so that a first integration produces a real accelerated query path rather than a demo.

  • Track the analytical data processing ecosystem: new engines, execution models, storage formats, and competing approaches to acceleration. Share what you learn with NVIDIA engineering, product, marketing, and the worldwide field organization to shape adoption strategy.

  • Collaborate with engine architects and NVIDIA engineering to resolve integration problems, establish best-practice patterns, and feed concrete technical requirements back to NVIDIA product teams.

  • Define the integration surface between NVIDIA's GPU data processing libraries and third-party query engines: where the plan handoff occurs, how execution and memory ownership are divided, and which of a partner's differentiating components remain in place alongside ours. Specify the APIs NVIDIA must expose to make that possible, and carry the patterns that work forward from one integration to the next.

  • Own the benchmark evidence for GPU-accelerated analytics. Design and run TPC-H, TPC-DS, and ClickBench measurements against the strongest available CPU baselines, separate cold and warm behavior, and publish results that hold up to outside scrutiny. Use those results to establish where the acceleration case is proven, where it is not yet, and what has to change.

  • Own the acceleration roadmap jointly with the projects and partners you work with: what gets built, in what order, and which technical bets are worth making. Earn that standing where the work happens, through upstream contribution and public design review in open source, and through joint architecture and roadmap planning with partner engineering leadership.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management, including hands-on experience with analytical data systems. Equivalent evidence of domain authority is weighed in place of years: published systems research, maintainership of a widely used data system, or core contributions to a query engine or data processing library.

  • Experience working with or supporting open source data projects and their contributor communities, commercial data platform and database ISVs, or cloud service provider data services.

  • Working proficiency in the internals of analytical data systems: query execution and optimization, vectorized and columnar processing, joins and aggregation, and storage formats such as Parquet and Arrow. Comfortable reading and contributing to a large C++, Rust, or Python codebase.

  • Comfort collaborating with cross-functional teams to discuss architecture, share feedback, and deliver technical presentations or demos.

  • Ability to manage and implement technical projects, solve integration challenges, and effectively communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong communication skills and a passion for helping developers innovate with NVIDIA tools and technology.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Committer, maintainer, or sustained contributor to a widely used open source data system..

  • Shipped an acceleration layer or engine integration into a commercial data platform, end to end.

  • Published or presented systems work at venues such as VLDB, SIGMOD, CIDR, or major open source community conferences..

  • Experience serving as technical counterpart to partner engineering leadership, including architecture review, design review, and joint roadmap planning.

  • Hands-on familiarity with advanced computing and GPU acceleration platforms, including CUDA, RAPIDS, cuDF, nvCOMP, and related CUDA-X libraries.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

  • Use technical ability to master trading platforms, internal tools, and proprietary systems, maintaining in-depth product knowledge through ongoing education.
  • Skillfully troubleshoot incoming inquiries, determining severity, and escalating to appropriate internal teams such as Compliance, Operations, and Technology when necessary, ensuring prompt resolution and diligent follow-up.
  • Make every trader interaction complete, using empathy as well as knowledge to provide white-glove care.
  • Actively participate in improving Tradeify.co’s trader-focused Learning Center and our internal knowledge bases to promote self-service capabilities for traders.
  • Contribute to team goals by focusing on customer satisfaction (CSAT), Quality Assurance, and overall response times.
  • Educate both existing and potential traders in their understanding of how Tradeify.co works.
  • Participate in beta testing new features and contribute to the overall growth and innovation of the company through idea generation and active participation in collaborative team projects.
  • Monitor trading systems for common issues and proactively identify potential problems that could impact the trader experience or operational flow.
  • Adhere strictly to all internal guidelines, compliance procedures, and industry best practices to ensure a secure, transparent, and trustworthy trading environment.
  • Potentially assist with data accuracy and reconciliation tasks as needed to support robust trading operations.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service, technical support, or operations role, preferably within a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to explain complex technical or financial information clearly, concisely, and empathetically.
  • Ability to type a minimum of 30 WPM.
  • Outstanding interaction with traders and customers is your top priority, demonstrating a reasonable understanding of white-glove care.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask effectively, prioritize competing demands, and manage time efficiently in a dynamic and high-pressure setting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving issues independently.
  • Proficiency in utilizing CRM software (e.g., Intercom, HubSpot) and other customer support tools to manage interactions and data.
  • Desire for proactive communication with colleagues and strong organizational skills.
  • Both goal- and results-oriented, with the ability to handle ambiguity with confidence and ease.
  • Willingness to notice and suggest improvements when necessary, and actively seeks feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work hours aligned with the US trading session, which may include early mornings or late evenings to ensure comprehensive coverage.
  • Must be fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Strong familiarity with or demonstrated genuine interest in prop trading, FX or Futures trading, cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and global financial markets.
  • Basic understanding of trading concepts, various financial products (e.g., futures, FX), or the operational intricacies of proprietary trading firms.
  • Prior experience with specific trading platforms such as NinjaTrader or Tradovate, TradingView etc.
  • Experience with community engagement platforms commonly used in the trading space, such as Telegram or Discord.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Interview: If we like your initial application, expect to schedule an interview with a member of our recruitment team. This interview will focus on getting to know you a bit more and will explain the culture of the company. We want to know more about why you want to join our team, how you feel about our company, and how it fits into your overall career plan to make sure this is the right place for you.
Interview(s) with your future manager: This is to make sure that you are a fit for the role you are applying to and to explore your career history. In this interview, we’ll learn more about the hard and soft skills you possess to help determine if you’d be a good fit for us.
Final Interview(s) with Leadership: Depending on the role, you may be interviewed by our senior leaders to assess your strategic thinking and fit within the broader team.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Design Manager (SDM) is a key leadership role within the Branch Project Development (BPD) Design Team, responsible for overseeing interior planning, design development, client engagement, and coordination across all project phases. The SDM ensures that design solutions align with Raymond James standards, project objectives, and client requirements while collaborating closely with Project Management and Workplace Strategy teams.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

1. Design Development & Technical Expertise

The SDM is responsible for delivering comprehensive Design Development (DD) packages for each project, including:

  • Approved space plans
  • Equipment and furniture plans
  • Power and data layouts
  • Reflected ceiling plans
  • Finish palettes, images, and specifications
  • Furniture details and selections
  • 3D model views, conceptual renderings, and visualization materials
  • Stay informed on emerging AI‑enabled design, visualization, documentation, and workflow tools relevant to workplace planning and interior design.
  • Evaluate and apply appropriate AI technologies to improve design efficiency, visualization quality, coordination accuracy, and client communication, while maintaining alignment with Raymond James standards.
  • Partner with leadership and cross‑functional teams on the responsible adoption of AI tools, supporting continuous improvement of design processes and deliverables.

Required Software Proficiency:
AutoCAD, Revit (or SketchUp), Enscape, Adobe Creative Suite, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Office

The SDM must be capable of analyzing, planning, designing, documenting, and managing interior non‑structural projects in compliance with applicable building codes, life‑safety standards, and corporate guidelines.

2. Project Design Leadership:

  • Use workplace strategy guidelines and approved programs to develop space plans and layouts that align with Raymond James design standards.
  • Ensure all new design standards, guidelines, and processes are consistently applied across all test fits and design deliverables.
  • Translate client standards into functional design solutions through iterative test fits.
  • Provide design direction and recommendations that address client business needs, operational requirements, and space optimization goals.
  • Verify that all preliminary and final design concepts are safe, functional, code‑compliant, and aesthetically appropriate.
  • Lead the development of finish selections and FF&E standards across multiple project types.
  • Create and maintain Revit templates based on approved design standards.
  • Produce conceptual-level Enscape renderings to support client understanding of proposed designs.

3. Client Management & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Serve as a primary design point‑of‑contact for internal and external clients.
  • Manage client expectations throughout all phases, facilitating reviews, gathering feedback, and obtaining required approvals.
  • Present design concepts and updates in formats that support strategic decision‑making.
  • Guide clients in interpreting and applying design standards, branding elements, and workplace requirements.
  • Participate in the development of client-specific design standards and branding materials.

4. Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Project Integration:

  • Coordinate closely with Project Management to align design milestones with overall project schedules, budgets, and deliverable timelines.
  • Participate in project kickoff meetings, site assessments, milestone reviews, and construction coordination sessions.
  • Provide timely design documentation to support permitting, vendor coordination, and construction activities.
  • Maintain strong partnership with Workplace Strategy and Design Teams to ensure design consistency across the portfolio.
  • Lead furniture coordination efforts, including detailed collaboration with the furniture dealer, architect, contractor, and internal teams to ensure accurate layouts, specifications, lead times, and installation planning.
  • Oversee art package coordination, working directly with clients and vendors to curate, review, and approve artwork selections consistent with branding and design intent.
  • Apply industry best practices and incorporate lessons learned from other supplier accounts.

5. Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement:

  • Review and refine test fits, drawings, and design deliverables to ensure accuracy and alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure consistent quality across all project types, from minor renovations to full‑scale buildouts.
  • Support standardization of design tools, templates, processes, and visual communication standards.

Educational/Previous Experience Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Project Management, or related field.
• 3–5 years of direct experience in workplace, commercial interior, or architectural with demonstrated success managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Highly self-motivated and independent, with the ability to proactively drive projects forward, make informed decisions, and manage priorities with limited oversight.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with internal stakeholders, external consultants, vendors, contractors, and branch clients.
  • Strong team coordination and collaboration skills, supporting Design Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional team members to ensure project goals, schedules, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify project challenges early and implement effective solutions.
  • Client-focused mindset, with a commitment to delivering a positive experience while balancing business, budget, and design objectives.
  • Proficiency in coordinating project documentation, design reviews, vendor communication, and project execution from concept through completion.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships across all levels of the organization and with external partners.
  • This is a hands-on, execution-focused position requiring active day-to-day project coordination and delivery rather than strategic leadership of a large team.

• Previous experience working in a financial services firm or other corporate environment is strongly preferred

Licenses/Certifications
• Architectural license, Interior Design license, LED certification is a plus

Education

Bachelor’s: Architecture, Bachelor’s: Interior Design

Work Experience

General Experience - 3 to 6 years

Certifications

Travel

Less than 25%

Workstyle

Remote

This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com.

Position Overview

The Lead focused on Governance and EU Accession opportunities provides strategic leadership to expand DAI's portfolio in these sectors. The role is responsible for developing and pursuing a pipeline of governance and EU accession opportunities, expanding DAI's network of partners and consultants, strengthening DAI's market position, and raising DAI's profile with key clients and stakeholders. The Lead will drive early pre-positioning and business growth efforts, foster strategic relationships, and contribute to the development of innovative and competitive solutions.

Alongside business development responsibilities, the role provides operational leadership across priority opportunities, ensuring high-quality outputs, effective resource management, financial sustainability, and achievement of organisational objectives. The Lead will work closely with bid, technical and implementation teams to support successful project delivery and contribute to DAI's continued growth and performance.

This is a full-time permanent position. This position requires the ability to work remotely in Spain without sponsorship. Barcelona is the preferred location but other locations in Spain will be considered.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement the sector related strategy.
  • Align to DAI Business Development objectives with organizational priorities and business goals.
  • Identify growth opportunities, partnerships, and new business initiatives, supporting consortium development and partnering strategies.
  • Monitor sector trends and provide strategic recommendations to the Lead, Public Sector Clients, EU.

Operational Management

  • Hands on day-to-day operations and ensure efficient pre-positioning, proposal preparation and quality review of the final product.
  • Establish performance targets and monitor progress against agreed objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, contractual requirements, and quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation within the Unit and beyond.
  • Provide strategic and technical support the project implementation team, helping to strengthen delivery and quality project outcomes.

People Management

  • Lead, motivate, and provide support to the development teammates.
  • Set performance objectives and conduct performance reviews when necessary.
  • Support workforce planning, recruitment, and onboarding.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture.

Market Positioning & Partnerships

  • Develop and maintain a network of specialist partners, consultants and technical experts across the governance and EU accession sectors, including donors and government counterparts
  • Raise DAI's visibility and reputation within the governance and EU accession sectors.
  • Build strategic intelligence on client priorities, procurement trends, competitor activity and market developments, undertaking missions in the field when necessary.
  • Represent DAI at industry events, working groups and conferences.
  • Develop thought leadership and knowledge products showcasing DAI's experience and capabilities
  • Identify partnership opportunities that strengthen DAI's technical and commercial competitiveness.

Quality and Risk Management

  • Ensure delivery of high-quality outputs and services.
  • Identify and mitigate operational, financial, and reputational risks.
  • Promote adherence to quality assurance and compliance frameworks.
  • Able and willing to adjust work schedule, as needed, to support teams located in different time zones/countries.

Other

  • Able and willing to travel to any country where DAI currently operates, or may wish to operate, barring times when DAI Global Security has deemed travel unsafe.
  • Additional responsibilities as deemed necessary.

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum Requirements:

  • Minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience working with the EU and other donors on business development, proposal development, and strategic positioning. Master’s degree in economics, Public Finance, Law, International Development, Public Policy, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • Strong understanding of the EU Global Gateway strategy and its relevance to governance and EU accession and international development programming.
  • Established professional network across EU institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, sector partners and relevant technical experts.
  • Demonstrated experience developing winning proposals, consortiums and technical solutions for complex donor-funded opportunities, preferably within the governance and EU accession sectors.
  • At least 10 years’ experience in a leadership or management role, including responsibility for teams, workplans, delivery quality, and performance management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, multidisciplinary teams, and complex programmes or projects in dynamic, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, client relationship management, partnership development, and business development skills.
  • Outstanding communication, leadership, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to represent the organisation effectively at senior levels.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Leadership and people development.
  • Financial acumen.
  • Decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Stakeholder management.
  • Results orientation.
  • Project and portfolio management.
  • Communication and influencing skills.

Preferred, but not required:

  • Professional working proficiency in a second language (Spanish or French preferred).

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or status as a protected veteran.

DAI upholds the highest ethical standards. We are committed to the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment as well as other ethical breaches. All our positions are therefore subject to stringent vetting and reference checks.

About Remote Legal

At Remote Legal, our 40-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash-in-the-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone.

About the role

Remote Legal is looking for skilled Legal Proofreaders to join our dedicated team. In this role, you’ll review and proof legal deposition, hearing, and other proceeding transcripts, working with the Transcript Production department to ensure a seamless experience to our clients and accurate record capture every step of the way.

The Legal Proofreader is responsible for reviewing deposition and legal transcripts to ensure accuracy, completeness, and client-ready quality. Proofers review transcripts according to assigned proofing levels, verify formatting and content, identify errors, and provide constructive feedback to editors through redlines, comments, and creates scorecards. This role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to deadlines, and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

What you'll do

  • Promptly acknowledge receipt of each proofreading assignment upon notification.
  • Consistently meet all assigned deadlines.
  • Download and review all necessary resources required to complete the assignment effectively.
  • Provide proofreading services according to the level assigned by the Transcript Production Team.
  • Carefully review transcripts for accuracy, grammar, punctuation, formatting, and consistency.
  • Review and clear indiscernible portions whenever possible using the available audio.
  • Verify the accuracy of the transcript caption and index and make corrections as needed.
  • Address questions or notes left by the editor in the transcript, or escalate unresolved issues to the Transcript Production Team.
  • Ensure Track Changes is enabled to produce a redline version of the transcript reflecting all edits.
  • Include instructional comments within the transcript to help editors improve accuracy on future assignments.
  • Provide feedback to the editor by submitting: a redlined transcript, illustrative comments explaining errors or corrections, and a completed proofreading scorecard in accordance with the scoring rubric.
  • If necessary, request deadline extensions at least one day prior to the deadline.
  • Upload the completed transcript and invoice upon completion of the assignment.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all information and materials entrusted to you.

Qualifications

  • Required:
    • Experience proofreading legal deposition transcripts
    • Experience proofing to audio
    • Attention to detail
    • Ability to meet deadlines
    • Understanding of the parts of a legal transcript, including formatting and styles
    • Ability to adhere to an established style guide
    • Good communication skills with Remote Legal internal teams to collaborate and ensure alignment on deadlines and transcript quality standards
  • Preferred:
    • Prior court reporting experience
    • Prior digital scoping experience

raw.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

This is a remote role that must be based in Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

About the team:

Platform Infrastructurebuilds, operates, and continuously evolves FYUL's container platform and cloud foundation. We foster a DevOps culture through self-service tooling, enabling product engineering teams to ship reliable, secure, and cost-efficient services as the business scales. The team owns our AWS cloud accounts, Kubernetes platform, cloud networking, observability stack, core databases, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code, and acts as the go-to partner for engineering teams on cloud and DevOps topics.


About the role:

We're hiring a Senior SRE II to join Platform Infrastructure as one of the team's senior individual contributors. At this level, you're the go-to person for our most complex infrastructure problems: you architect and drive large-scale automation and reliability initiatives, set standards other engineers follow, and mentor Associate and mid-level SREs. You'll split your time between hands-on platform work - Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, CI/CD, observability - and technical leadership: proposing designs, reviewing others' work, and helping the team make good build-vs-buy and cost/reliability trade-offs.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Infrastructure & reliability: Architect and manage highly available, secure, and scalable infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and environments using infrastructure as code.

  • Design and operate our Amazon EKS clusters, including networking policies, persistent storage, and scaling strategies for containerized workloads.

  • Own and evolve core platform services:cloud networking, Kubernetes, and the databases and messaging systems engineering teams depend on.

  • Automation & infrastructure as code: Drive large-scale automation projects and set standards for using Terraform / Terragrunt and GitOps (ArgoCD) across teams.

  • Lead adoption of automation to reduce manual operational work and keep environments consistent and repeatable.

  • Observability & incident response: Be the go-to person for solving complex, cross-service infrastructure problems.

  • Drive initiatives that improve reliability and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) so systems scale with minimal manual intervention.

  • Participate in on-call rotation, lead incident response for production issues, and write clear runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems.

  • Security & cost efficiency: Lead security efforts within the team - IAM, encryption, secure logging - and mentor others on secure infrastructure practices.

  • Audit infrastructure spend regularly and drive cost optimization across the platform (rightsizing, autoscaling, FinOps practices).

  • Collaboration & mentorship: Mentor mid-level SREs, provide detailed feedback, and support onboarding of new team members.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Partner with product engineering squads to understand their needs and represent Platform Infrastructure in cross-team initiatives.

Your qualifications:

These reflect the technical bar we hold Senior SRE II's to internally, based on our SRE competency framework and current stack.

  1. Core technical experience:

  • Solid Linux systems administration background and comfort scripting in Python.

  • Strong AWS knowledge: EKS, IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC networking, RDS, S3, SQS, and familiarity with the Well-Architected Framework; experience in multi-account AWS environments is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting Kubernetes (EKS) at production scale, including Helm chart development, CNI networking (we run Cilium), pod networking/IPAM concepts, and container security (ECR, image scanning).

  • Proficiency with Terraform (modules, state management) and ideally Terragrunt for multi-environment management; GitOps experience with ArgoCD.

  • Experience with Postgres, MySQL and/or MongoDB in production scale, including Aurora.

  • CI/CD experience with Jenkins (Jenkinsfile, shared libraries) and/or GitHub Actions, and familiarity with deployment strategies such as blue-green and canary.

  • Experience with the Grafana observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) - metrics design, dashboarding, alerting, log aggregation, and distributed tracing. Not only using but also maintaining it.

  • Practical incident management experience: on-call rotations, structured incident response, and writing runbooks/postmortems.

  • Working knowledge of 12-Factor App principles and cost optimization / FinOps awareness.

    2.How you work:

  • A methodical, data-driven approach to troubleshooting rather than guessing.

  • Strong written communication - you write runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems that others can actually follow.

  • Comfortable driving initiatives with ambiguous ownership, and taking accountability for outcomes rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Track record of mentoring less senior engineers and giving direct, constructive feedback.

  • Several years of hands-on production infrastructure/SRE experience, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives at a senior individual-contributor level (leading design work, setting standards, being the escalation point for hard problems).

    3. Nice to have:

  • GCP Experience.

  • Experience with Kafka / AWS MSK.

  • Prior experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (security best practices, access reviews).

  • Experience contributing to a platform/DevEx roadmap that other engineering teams consume as a self-service product.

Our tech stack:

  • Languages:PHP (Symfony), Node.js (TypeScript), Angular (TypeScript).

  • Data:PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.

  • Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis

  • Engineering Tools:Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus.

  • Remote work Tools:Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Development Practices:Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

Senior CMS Solution Architect / Technical Lead

Contract | Remote, Canada | Potential travel within Canada

About the opportunity

Aequilibrium is assembling a senior technical team for a potential large-scale digital experience modernization initiative involving a multi-site, multi-brand public web ecosystem.

We are looking for a Senior CMS Solution Architect / Technical Lead with deep experience architecting and delivering enterprise CMS/DXP implementations and migrations. The hourly rate for this multi year contract position is b/w $80/h-$100/h.

The successful candidate will help define the technical architecture, guide the implementation team and ensure the solution is secure, scalable, maintainable and appropriate for a complex public-facing digital ecosystem.

What you'll do

  • Define the overall CMS/DXP solution architecture for a multi-site environment.
  • Translate business, UX and content requirements into a scalable technical architecture.
  • Define content models, reusable components, templates and multi-site architecture.
  • Guide CMS configuration and implementation while minimizing unnecessary customization.
  • Develop the approach for migrating a large existing content estate from a legacy enterprise CMS.
  • Define integration patterns with identity, analytics, search and other enterprise systems.
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish development standards.
  • Guide full-stack developers and review implementation quality.
  • Establish security-by-design principles across the solution.
  • Collaborate with DevOps/SRE specialists on cloud architecture, environments and CI/CD.
  • Address performance, scalability, monitoring, logging and operational requirements.
  • Support technical documentation, knowledge transfer and production readiness.

What we're looking for

Strong candidates will have:

  • 10+ years of software/solution architecture experience with substantial CMS/DXP experience.
  • Led at least 2 significant enterprise CMS implementations or re-platforming initiatives.
  • Experience designing multi-site / multi-brand CMS architectures.
  • Experience with modern headless or hybrid CMS architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience.
  • Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong understanding of web security, privacy, RBAC, SSO/identity and observability.
  • Experience with large-scale automated and manual content migrations.
  • Experience working with UX, content and design-system teams rather than operating solely as a backend architect.
  • Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills.

Particularly valuable experience

We are especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • dotCMS implementation experience
  • Liferay migration experience
  • Government or Canadian public-sector digital transformation
  • Large-scale multi-site implementations
  • AWS-based managed CMS environments
  • Canadian data residency requirements
  • SOC 2 environments
  • Entra ID / enterprise identity integration
  • WCAG 2.2 AA public websites

Experience with enterprise platforms such as dotCMS, Liferay, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Drupal, Optimizely or comparable platforms is relevant, although direct dotCMS experience would be particularly valuable.

When applying, please describe 2–3 enterprise CMS projects you personally architected or led, including the source and target CMS where applicable, number of sites, approximate scale and your specific responsibilities.

Our Company

Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets.
Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world.
Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security.
By combining asset ownership with advanced technologies and integration expertise, Energy Vault is building the next generation of critical energy infrastructure, delivering dependable power when and where it matters most.
Learn more at , explore recent updates in our Newsroom, and connect with us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo, or YouTube.

Our Values

We Commit: To Building a Better Future for Earth and All Its Beings.
We Innovate: Cutting Edge Solutions to Accelerate the Unique Energy Aspirations of Our Clients.
We Connect: To Build Genuine Relationships.
We Deliver: Going Above & Beyond by Being Fast & Nimble.
We Lead: With Authenticity and Purpose.

Your Impact as a Director, Asset Management:

The Director of Asset Management is responsible for overseeing the performance, reliability, and commercial success of utility-scale Energy Storage Systems. This role ensures the assets operate efficiently, meet performance and compliance targets, and deliver expected returns throughout their lifecycle. The Asset Manager will serve as the key liaison among internal stakeholders, O&M providers, QSEs, off-takers and utility partners.

Your Mission:

    Compliance & Reporting

    • Ensure compliance with ERCOT, NERC, and local regulatory requirements.
    • Manage contracts for NERC registration and compliance services and periodic ERCOT testing.
    • Maintain accurate and auditable records of operational events, tests, and maintenance.
    • Assist in preparing asset reports for internal stakeholders, investors, and regulators.

      • Commercial Optimization

      • Coordinate with distribution service provider, ERCOT, QSE and offtake partners to validate operational revenues and cost.
      • Ensure all invoices and revenue/cost statements are accurate and ensure timely payment (including, Property tax, offtake revenue, Aux energy cost etc.).
      • Support forecasting, budgeting, and revenue modelling activities.

        • Operations & Maintenance

        • Work closely with internal and external O&M providers to schedule preventive and corrective maintenance and BESS testing.
        • Review and manage service agreements, warranty obligations, and long-term service plans.
        • Ensure all maintenance activities are properly documented and reported.

          • Transition and Stakeholder Support

          • Support project handoff from construction to operations, ensuring asset readiness.
          • Serve as the primary point of contact for asset-related inquiries and issues.

            • Asset Performance Management

            • Monitor operational performance of BESS assets via EMS/SCADA systems.
            • Identify underperformance or anomalies and coordinate resolution with field and OEM teams.

Your Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Energy, Business, or a related field.
  • 9+ years of experience in asset management, operations, or performance monitoring in the energy sector (BESS or renewables preferred).
  • Over 3 years of experience managing NERC Bulk Electric System (BES) compliance activities.
  • Strong understanding of financial and commercial aspects of energy storage projects.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, financial modeling, and performance reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SCADA, EMS systems.
  • Familiarity with ISO markets (ERCOT, CAISO, PJM, etc.) and revenue strategies.
  • Strong data analysis, reporting, and communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, with familiarity in asset management platforms.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and/or internationally, up to 25%.
  • Comfortable thriving in fast-paced, rapid growth environments.
  • A passion for sustainability, our mission, and our vision is a bonus!
  • Must successfully pass a pre-employment background check.
  • Energy Vault participates in E-Verify.

Benefits of Powering the Future with Energy Vault:

  • Annual bonus plan.
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
  • 401K employer matching.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for employees and family.
  • Flexible Spending Account.
  • Company-paid Life insurance, Short- and Long-term disability insurance.
  • 8-weeks for Paternity leave.
  • Generous holiday allowance.
  • Flexible time off plus sick leave.
  • Reimbursement for home office equipment, phone, and internet expenses.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction, and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern web technologies and data processing tools, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $37 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
Location: Remote – South Africa
Sector: Technology & Finance
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 09:00–17:00 UK time, Monday to Friday

Role Overview

Our client is a specialist UK-based executive search consultancy operating across the Technology and Finance sectors. They are seeking an experienced and polished Senior Executive Search Resourcer to support senior-level and executive search assignments across the UK, Europe and the United States.

This role is focused on identifying, engaging and qualifying high-calibre professionals at Director, VP, C-suite and senior leadership level.

This is not a high-volume recruitment or CV sourcing position. The successful candidate will be expected to take a highly targeted, research-led and consultative approach to executive search. You will build detailed market maps, approach passive candidates with credibility, conduct meaningful qualification conversations and develop long-term relationships with senior professionals.

You will work closely with Executive Search Consultants and Partners, providing high-quality candidate intelligence, market insight and research throughout the search lifecycle.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

  • Identify and headhunt senior-level candidates across specialist Technology and Finance markets.
  • Conduct detailed market mapping to identify relevant companies, teams, leadership structures and potential candidates.
  • Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, internal databases and targeted research.
  • Engage passive candidates at Director, VP, C-suite and executive level in a professional and credible manner.
  • Conduct detailed candidate qualification and screening calls.
  • Assess candidates based on experience, leadership capability, career motivations, compensation expectations and future objectives.
  • Build a strong understanding of each candidate's professional background and suitability for specific executive search assignments.
  • Present well-qualified and accurately documented candidate profiles to the Executive Search Consultant or Partner.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior professionals, rather than engaging candidates solely for immediate vacancies.
  • Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the search process.
  • Gather market intelligence relating to organisational structures, senior appointments, leadership movements and competitor activity.
  • Identify potential commercial intelligence and business development opportunities uncovered through candidate conversations and market research.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, notes, search activity and follow-up actions within the ATS and CRM.
  • Support the preparation of candidate reports, market maps, longlists, shortlists and search documentation.
  • Assist with interview coordination and candidate management throughout the recruitment process.
  • Provide ongoing market feedback to Consultants regarding candidate availability, compensation trends and market sentiment.
  • Contribute to the continuous development of the firm's candidate network across Technology and Finance.

Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate should have:

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience within executive search, permanent recruitment, recruitment research or senior-level resourcing.
  • Proven experience sourcing and engaging Director, VP, C-suite or other senior-level professionals.
  • Previous experience working within executive search or a highly targeted headhunting environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience recruiting internationally, ideally across the UK, Europe and/or United States.
  • Strong market mapping and candidate research skills.
  • Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates.
  • Excellent candidate qualification and consultative interviewing skills.
  • Confidence discussing senior-level career moves, motivations, compensation and leadership experience.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility with senior professionals.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how candidate conversations can generate useful market and business intelligence.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms and CRM systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate candidate documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple executive search assignments simultaneously.
  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with the wider search team.

Technology & Finance Market Exposure

Experience recruiting within one or more of the following areas would be advantageous:

Technology

  • Software and SaaS
  • FinTech
  • Data and Analytics
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud and Infrastructure
  • Digital Transformation
  • Technology Leadership
  • Product and Engineering
  • IT Services and Consulting

Finance

  • Financial Services
  • Banking
  • Private Equity
  • Investment Management
  • FinTech
  • Corporate Finance
  • Accounting and Finance Leadership
  • Risk and Compliance
  • Insurance
  • CFO and senior finance leadership appointments

Candidates do not necessarily need experience across both Technology and Finance, provided they have strong executive search expertise within a relevant specialist market.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Professional, polished and credible when communicating with senior executives.
  • Naturally inquisitive and comfortable asking detailed questions.
  • Consultative rather than transactional in their approach.
  • Confident speaking with Director, VP and C-suite professionals.
  • Skilled at building trust and developing long-term candidate relationships.
  • Comfortable challenging candidates and thoroughly assessing their suitability.
  • Commercially aware and able to recognise valuable market intelligence.
  • Research-driven and able to understand complex organisational structures and specialist markets.
  • Persistent and confident when approaching passive candidates.
  • Highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
  • Detail-oriented when recording candidate and market information.
  • Focused on delivering quality rather than volume.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of search assignments.
  • Motivated by working within a high-quality executive search environment.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • The quality and relevance of candidates identified.
  • Ability to engage difficult-to-reach senior professionals.
  • Quality and depth of candidate qualification.
  • Accuracy and completeness of market mapping.
  • Strength of candidate relationships developed over time.
  • Quality of candidate profiles presented to Consultants and Partners.
  • Consistency of candidate follow-up and pipeline management.
  • Quality of market intelligence gathered.
  • Contribution to successful executive search assignments.
  • Accuracy of ATS and CRM records.
  • Ability to identify potential commercial opportunities through market conversations.

Benefits

Working Requirements

  • Full-time position.
  • Monday to Friday.
  • 09:00–17:00 UK time.
  • Fully remote from South Africa.
  • Reliable internet connection and professional home-working environment required.
  • Regular telephone and video conversations with senior candidates across international markets will form a core part of the role.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Industry Consulting Snr. Consultant to join our team in New York, Remote, New York (US-NY), United States (US).

Job Description

In this role you will be joining a team of technical professionals supporting a large-scale z/OS systems platform. This position requires an experienced systems programmer with at least 3 years of experience supporting the z/OS Mainframe Network environment. Responsibilities include configuring and maintaining the integrity and data/IP security of the Mainframe's host communication subsystems and associated program products.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Being part of a multi-functional team, supporting IBM mainframe networks and transmissions products and infrastructure.
  • Participation in support rota providing 24x7 cover.
  • Perform TCPIP Port Reserves (Additions, Deletions, Changes) Perform VTAM updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes)
  • Manage OSA Adapters in a complex mainframe environment
  • Perform VTAM PU/LU updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes) including Enterprise Extenders (EE)
  • Implement AT-TLS rules (digital certificate management). Configure and manage IPSEC policies (permit/deny rules, VPN- ipsec tunnels)
  • Trace, Debug and Error Analysis
  • Communicate regularly with technical, applications and operational staff to ensure Network connectivity and security (may involve some after hours and weekend work)

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Experience of working as a z/OS Systems Specialist in the IT industry of over 10+ years

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in administering file transmissions products such as Connect:Direct and FTP, or alternatively good experience as a user of these products.
  • Knowledge of z/OS and z/OS utilities.
  • Understanding of z/OS networking services, structure and related software and protocols.
  • Understanding of network security disciplines (IPSec, TLS/SSL, certificates, etc) and how they relate to file transmission.
  • Experience of problem management from initial diagnosis through to resolution.
  • Understanding of the Change Management process.
  • Ability to customize and manage secure SNA and TCP/IP networks under z/OS.
  • Knowledge of mainframe network management tools, e.g. NetMaster, and multi-session manager products such as TUBES and Supersession.
  • Experience of managing mainframe printing products.
  • General z/OS systems programming experience.
  • Knowledge of System z hardware including the OSA-Express network cards.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Good communication, teamwork and negotiation skills
  • Familiarity with the Cisco Network Solutions
  • The ability to work to tight deadlines under pressure
  • Good organisational skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability
  • The ability to create and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues and customers
  • Business awareness and understanding of business requirements of IT
  • A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology
  • An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act.

The role is based at our Sheffield or Wakefield datacentres and offers the flexibility to work from home for part of the week

Summary

This leader will develop and execute a multi-year finance transformation roadmap focused on process standardization, technology modernization, organizational effectiveness, data and analytics, and enhanced business decision support.

The role serves as a key partner to Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, Procurement, and IT leaders to drive enterprise-wide initiatives that improve financial performance, scalability, reporting capabilities, controls, and customer service while reducing complexity and cost.

Core Responsibilities

Finance Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and lead the enterprise finance transformation strategy aligned with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance effectiveness, efficiency, scalability, and business partnership capabilities.
  • Build and maintain a multi-year roadmap across people, process, technology, data, and governance dimensions.

  • Order-to-Cash (O2C)

  • Forecast-to-Plan (F2P)

  • Cost Accounting

  • Allocation methodology and reporting

  • Financial system map/design

Other possible areas/processes for improvement or documentation

  • Support design process owner framework
  • Implement best practices, automation, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Systems and Digital Enablement

  • Partner with IT and business leaders to modernize the finance technology landscape.
  • Lead ERP optimization initiatives.

Drive adoption of technologies including:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions
  • Improve data quality, reporting consistency, and enterprise decision-making capabilities.

Financial Planning and Analytics

  • Improve visibility into profitability by customer, product, channel, distribution center, and geography.
  • Promote data-driven decision making throughout the organization.

Program Leadership and Change Management

  • Drive organizational adoption through structured change management and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Build transformation capabilities and continuous improvement culture across finance teams.

Talent and Leadership

  • Coach finance leaders on process excellence, digital capabilities, and change leadership.
  • Foster a culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifying Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or related field.
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced certification preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive finance leadership experience.
  • 5+ years leading large-scale finance transformation programs.
  • Experience within distribution, wholesale, manufacturing, consumer products, industrial products, healthcare products, or supply chain-intensive industries.
  • Demonstrated success leading ERP implementations/enhancements and finance modernization initiatives.
  • Experience managing large cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide projects.

Technical Expertise

- Deep understanding of:

  • Financial planning and analysis
  • Accounting and controllership processes
  • Supply chain finance
  • Inventory and cost accounting
  • Shared services operations
  • Business process redesign
  • Program and project management

- Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, or other major enterprise systems.
- Strong knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools.

The Role

At CompanyCam, the Sr. Director of Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data owns the architecture, administration, and roadmap of our MarTech stack, our marketing data strategy, and the paid and owned digital channel strategy that stack is built to support. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing and serving on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team, you'll build and lead a Marketing Operations team responsible for Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, Webflow, and our ad platform stack, and lead a website development team with real engineers and engineering process.

This is a hands-on technical leader, not a generalist who manages people who understand the tools better than they do. You should be equally comfortable evaluating an integration decision, setting channel mix strategy, and translating marketing data into recommendations for the SLT.

Location: Remote - Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Own the MarTech roadmap and architecture across Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, Webflow, and the ad platform stack, defining how systems integrate and how data flows end to end
  • Build and lead a Marketing Operations team that administers and governs the MarTech stack, and co-owns Webflow with the Web/Brand team
  • Own the integrated paid and owned digital channel strategy, setting channel mix, investment priorities, and performance targets
  • Own CompanyCam's marketing data strategy, including the data model and data integrity across Marketing's systems
  • Lead the marketing website development team, owning the engineering roadmap, sprint process, and release/QA process for the marketing site
  • Lead and develop the Director of Growth Operations, Sr. Marketing Optimization Manager, Marketing Operations team, and website development team
  • Serve as the Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data voice on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems, and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you'll drive impact by:

  • Building a MarTech architecture and marketing data strategy that scales with the business instead of constraining it
  • Leading a real engineering function for the marketing website, raising code quality and release discipline
  • Setting a digital channel strategy that connects investment directly to pipeline and acquisition outcomes
  • Giving the Marketing SLT a technical and data-driven voice they can act on
  • Developing directors and senior managers into stronger, more autonomous leaders

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years in digital marketing, marketing technology, or marketing operations leadership, including 5+ years directly owning a MarTech stack and leading technical or operations teams in B2B SaaS or high-growth technology
  • Proven, hands-on ownership of core MarTech platforms: Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, and Webflow, including administration, architecture, and integration decisions
  • Experience leading a website development function, including engineering process and technical site architecture, not just content or design oversight
  • Deep understanding of marketing data architecture: data models, integrations, APIs, and ETL/automation tools like Workato, , Hightouch, or Zapier
  • Demonstrated expertise developing integrated digital channel strategies across paid and owned channels
  • Proven ability to partner with analytics and data engineering teams on measurement frameworks and attribution models
  • Experience managing agency and vendor relationships for paid media and web development
  • Experience evaluating and optimizing team operating models, including in-house vs. outsourced resourcing

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $195,000-$225,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

This role owns the vision and execution of global learning programs that drive adoption, deepen product proficiency, and deliver measurable business outcomes for clients and partners, working cross-functionally and with other members of FICO’s Integrated Learning Organization (ILO). This leader combines strategy with domain and technical depth, and can move seamlessly between vision, cross-functional leadership, and hands-on support of high‑impact learning and enablement initiatives.
