raw.title: Site Navigator II (Study Start-up Specialist) - Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide
raw.excerpt: Job Overview:Site Navigators II plays a critical role in the comprehensive coordination of site-level activities throughout the start-up phase of a clinical study and potentially through closeout activities as required.
raw.description:
Job Overview:

Site Navigators II plays a critical role in the comprehensive coordination of site-level activities throughout the start-up phase of a clinical study and potentially through closeout activities as required. Serving as the single point of contact for investigative sites, this role ensures smooth progression from feasibility and initial outreach through to site activation, extending through the maintenance phase of the study as required. A crucial component in meeting the requirements of the Site Navigator II role is ensuring regulatory compliance, robust site management, optimal site support and training, and effective collaboration between the sponsor, CRO, and clinical site staff. This role serves as a local expert in project start-up/clinical activities for a particular country or region, performs work with limited oversight, and acts as a ‘knowledge resource’ to mentor and train junior colleagues if suitable.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Oversight of site level tasks associated with efficient site activation in accordance with ICH/GCP guidelines, local regulations, SOPs and project requirements, including collaboration with project leadership and local monitors to collaboratively achieve project milestones while also ensuring patient rights, wellbeing and safety are protected

  • Identifying potential research sites that align with the study's criteria and assessing their capabilities and resources.

  • Conduct initial site outreach, i.e., site engagement, collection of Confidentiality Agreement, and feasibility survey

  • Remote Pre-Study Visits and follow up documentation, including visit preparation, trip report completion, and other documentation as required to support site selection in line with sponsor, protocol, local and country regulations and requirements

  • Support customization and translation of informed consent forms and patient-facing materials.

  • Collect, track and perform a quality review of all essential documents required for effective and compliant study site activation from Site outreach, submissions, greenlight and until site activation. Maintenance and ongoing awareness of site regulatory compliance, supporting IRB/Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) annual renewals, PI change-over, and document expirations will be performed as applicable in accordance with local requirements.

  • Actively participate in team meetings to facilitate study progress and implement action plans for site level risks, underperforming sites, or issues impacting project milestones and escalate issues in a timely manner

  • Support the CRA team in preparing for site initiation visits (SIVs) by coordinating with vendors, supplies teams, and study leads to ensure timely distribution of clinical study supplies, accesses and documents per study team guidance.

  • Responsible for submissions to and liaise with applicable IRB/IEC, Third Bodies (if applicable), and Regulatory Authorities by collaborating with Global Regulatory Submissions Lead (GRSL)

  • Perform initial contract and budget negotiations with the sites, as well as amended where applicable

  • Ensure high quality documents are filed in applicable systems in accordance with SOPs and project requirements and that the Trial Master File (TMF) is updated and audit ready at all times.

  • Track the progress of the start-up process and ensure that the research site meets all requirements and deadlines.

  • Ensure Fortrea is audit ready by completing accurate, timely, and consistent system compliance on an ongoing basis

  • Serve as primary contact for investigative sites and ensure timely delivery in alignment with scope of work/study budget

  • Perform Case Report Form (CRF) review and data validation against source documentation according to protocol and guidelines as applicable in combination with monitoring for site protocol deviations, Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, and all other duties as needed or assigned throughout the course of the study.

  • Perform country and site ICF review/customization, per local requirements

  • All other duties as needed or assigned

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/College degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) or 3+ years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH/GCP guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations.

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

  • In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with a High School Diploma or equivalent AND a minimum of 5 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH/GCP guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations will be considered.

  • Fluent in local official language and in English, both written and verbal.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • A scientific degree and/ or clinical expertise is optimal for this role.

  • Minimum of 2 +year of experience in clinical start-up/ regulatory process (RGO and Ethics submissions).

  • Working knowledge of ICH/GCP, RA, TGA, Belberry, and other applicable regulations/guidelines; familiarity with investigator start-up documents and contract/budgets negotiation process; previous interaction with operational project teams and investigative sites.

  • Demonstrated understanding of research protocol requirements and proven ability to communicate and educate others about them.

  • Effective communication with various stakeholders, including site staff, CRO personnel, and regulatory authorities.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously, ensuring that all requirements are met in a timely manner.

  • Understanding of relevant regulations and guidelines related to clinical trials and research.

  • Ability to identify and resolve potential issues that may arise during the start-up process.

  • Ability to negotiate contracts and budgets effectively with research sites.

  • Employees will leverage their existing experience and skills to assume additional responsibilities within the broader role. These will be aligned with operational requirements and internal training, without altering the fundamental nature or classification of the position.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

  • Remote-based work required with possible office presence depending on location

  • Travel requirements: Limited for training only

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare Advanced Imaging Solutions (AIS) portfolio is transforming healthcare through intelligent imaging, AI-enabled technologies, and connected care pathways. The Content and Creative Lead will play a critical role in shaping the content strategy. This role ensures every creative solution is strategically aligned with business objectives, delivers a consistent GE HealthCare brand experience, and produces measurable business impact.
Reporting to the Head of Creative & Storytelling, this individual will oversee concept development, storytelling, messaging, creative quality, and innovation while leveraging emerging AI technologies to accelerate ideation, improve workflows, and enhance creative quality. AI will be used as a creative accelerator and not as a replacement for human judgment or the creation of final customer-facing content.

Job Description

Content Development

The Content & Creative Lead will be responsible for developing and guiding high-quality content across campaigns, channels, and customer touchpoints. This includes writing, editing, and shaping messaging for campaign concepts, digital assets, event materials, video scripts, social content, presentations, sales enablement, and internal communications. The role requires the ability to translate complex healthcare solutions into clear, compelling, audience-specific content that aligns with GE HealthCare’s brand voice, business objectives, and compliance requirements.

  • Develop compelling narratives that translate complex healthcare technologies into clear customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product Marketing, Commercial, Clinical, and Corporate Communications teams to build integrated campaign strategies.
  • Guide content architecture across the customer journey—from awareness through advocacy.
  • Ensure messaging reflects customer insights, business priorities, and clinical relevance.

Creative Quality & Governance

  • Establish creative standards and review processes that ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Provide creative direction and coaching to designers, copywriters, agencies, and production teams.
  • Conduct creative reviews and maintain consistency across global campaigns.
  • Champion continuous improvement in storytelling, visual design, and customer experience.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with:

  • Marketing Leaders
  • Product Marketing
  • Commercial Teams
  • Clinical Marketing
  • Brand & Communications
  • Project Management
  • External Agency Partners
  • Legal & Regulatory
  • Act as a trusted creative advisor to business stakeholders.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current on healthcare marketing trends, emerging technologies, and creative best practices.
  • Introduce new approaches to storytelling, content creation, and customer engagement.
  • Evaluate creative performance and recommend improvements based on data and customer feedback.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, and innovation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8+ years of experience in creative leadership, content development or integrated marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level creative campaigns.
  • Exceptional storytelling, messaging, and creative direction skills.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, branding, customer experience, and campaign development.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across matrixed organizations.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, medical technology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries.
  • Experience working within an internal creative agency or integrated marketing organization.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud, Workfront, Digital Asset Management (DAM) platforms, and collaborative creative workflows.
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $76,000.00-$114,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Summary:

Alongside Wiz's broader Sales and Customer Success teams, our Renewal Manager is playing a critical role in Wiz's customer retention and expansion strategy.

Wiz is looking for a Renewal Manager who is motivated, collaborative and process-oriented to secure up-for-renewal dollars and mitigate renewal risk. Ideal candidates will exhibit high levels of business and sales acumen all the while maintaining a customer-first approach.

What you'll do:

  • Handle the quote-to-close process for renewals 120 to 90 days in advance of renewal due date
  • Achieve or exceed quarterly revenue goals, tied to retention, growth and term extension of existing customer contracts
  • Partner with Customer Success to assess customer health and drive the appropriate renewal solution
  • Maintain and report an accurate forecast of renewals within assigned book
  • Manage the renewal process for multiple commercial customers concurrently and be comfortable with maintaining organization through scale
  • Escalate whenever appropriate to help resolve customer concerns
  • Identify “at-risk” renewal clients before renewal date and escalate to appropriate team members, mitigate contraction and churn within all deals
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with our channel and alliance partners in order to identify and close joint opportunities
  • Collaborate cross functionally with Legal and Deals Desk as applicable
  • Recommend and contribute to process improvements

What you'll bring:

  • 2-5 related cybersecurity and renewals experience
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • High collaborative with ability to succeed in an entrepreneurial environment
  • Proven track record of success and over-achievement of renewal quota in previous positions
  • Deep understanding of SaaS offerings and pricing models and ability to learn Wiz's offerings and pricing with agility
  • Experience in SaaS revenue organization: Sales, CSM, or prior renewals team experience
  • Familiarity with systems: Salesforce, CPQ, IronClad, ChurnZero
  • Confidence and ability to navigate customer and partner renewal processes per Wiz rules of engagement

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need forvisa sponsorship.This role does not offervisasponsorship.

Deputy Project Manager / Technical Lead

Location: Florida, Remote

Tallahassee metro preferred, within 50 miles

Candidates must reside in Florida

Compensation: $90,000–$100,000

Employment Type: Full Time, W-2

Start: Contingent upon contract award

About Emerging Tech

At Emerging Tech, we support government and public sector customers through technology, cybersecurity, and mission driven solutions. As a growing SDVOSB, 8(a), and HUBZone company, we provide our team with the opportunity to take ownership, work directly with clients and leadership, and contribute to meaningful government missions.

We’re big enough to take on meaningful government work, but still small enough that your expertise and ideas have a direct impact. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with talented teams, and having a real role in building something that’s growing, you’ll fit right in at Emerging Tech.

Role Overview

The Deputy Project Manager / Technical Lead will report to the Project Manager and serve as the second in command for the program, while acting as the technical lead for cybersecurity testing activities.

This role will translate program objectives into executable testing strategies and detailed procedures, coordinate technical execution across concurrent agency engagements, review findings and root cause determinations, support project management activities, and assume Project Manager responsibilities when needed.

This is a growth opportunity with direct exposure to senior technical practitioners and a funded certification pathway.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the Testing Strategy and Detailed Testing Procedures, including the pre approved technique catalog and rules of engagement.
  • Own the traceability matrix linking each test to its MITRE ATT&CK technique, NIST CSF subcategory, regulatory criterion, and expected telemetry source.
  • Oversee emission, observation, and outcome reconciliation across concurrent agency engagements.
  • Review findings and root cause classifications for completeness and consistency before client release.
  • Define and enforce testing safety controls, including risk ratings, rollback procedures, agency deconfliction contacts, and stop work triggers.
  • Serve as the day to day technical point of contact for agency security and information technology staff.
  • Ensure testing remains within approved scope and obtain documented written client authorization for any changes.
  • Support executive and audit briefings regarding testing methodology, results, cybersecurity risks, and findings.
  • Support the Project Manager with program management responsibilities and assume Project Manager duties when required.

Required Technical Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, assessment, audit, or security operations.
  • Experience serving as a technical point of contact or coordinating technical testing activities on at least one engagement.
  • Experience contributing to cybersecurity testing procedures, playbooks, or assessment methodologies.
  • Exposure to detection validation, purple team, or security operations activities beyond configuration based compliance assessments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining cybersecurity testing procedures, playbooks, and evidence standards.
  • Hands on experience performing penetration testing, configuration reviews, cloud assessments, or security control validation.
  • Working knowledge of detection engineering and SIEM effectiveness testing, including common causes of missed detection such as absent telemetry, broken log pipelines, missing detection content, alert tuning, and failed analyst triage.
  • Familiarity with adversary simulation and threat emulation frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, Atomic Red Team, or MITRE CALDERA.
  • Experience creating risk based testing plans aligned to NIST CSF control categories.
  • Strong working knowledge of Active Directory, Windows security architecture, Microsoft Entra ID, major cloud platforms, identity management, logging, and monitoring technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical activities across multiple agencies and testing environments concurrently.
  • Experience creating testing procedures, scripts, playbooks, and evidence collection methodologies.
  • Strong technical writing skills, including testing strategies, procedures, and technical memoranda.
  • Experience briefing executive leadership and audit personnel on cybersecurity risks and findings.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of cybersecurity consulting, assessment, audit, or security operations experience.
  • Experience coordinating technical testing activities.
  • Experience contributing to cybersecurity testing procedures, playbooks, or assessment methodologies.

• Must reside in the state of Florida.

Certifications

Required: At least one of the following:

  • Security+

• CySA+

• GSEC

  • CEH
    • PenTest+

• GCIH

Preferred:

  • CISSP

• CISA

• OSCP

  • CRTO
    • GCIA
    • GCDA
    • SC-200

• PMP

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior technical delivery supporting an Office of Inspector General or independent audit function.
  • Experience operating under formal rules of engagement in production government environments.
  • Prior experience working in a Florida state agency information security or information technology role.

Working Conditions

This is a remote position for Florida based candidates. The Tallahassee metro area, within approximately 50 miles, is preferred.

The role requires significant technical coordination with government stakeholders, cybersecurity teams, and agency personnel across multiple concurrent engagements.

As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

SUMMARY

As a Principal Solutions Engineer you will work closely with Wiz’s CTO, Field CTO, Customer Success, Product Management, and R&D organizations to maintain alignment and ensure coordinated efforts across the sales process.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Strong technical background with a solid understanding of core IT, InfoSec, Cloud, and DevOps concepts.
  • Proven skillset and experience with a career path focused on public cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Deep, practical knowledge of the AppSec landscape, including Application Security Posture Management (ASPM), SAST, DAST, SCA, and the operational use of SBOMs (SPDX/CycloneDX) and their practical use cases for vulnerability and license management.
  • Demonstrable proficiency in one or more high-level languages (e.g., Python, Go, Rust) and/or advanced shell scripting.
  • Experience and ability to code and understand developer workflows. Git, CI/CD, helm, terraform etc
  • SME level knowledge of Kubernetes and containers with the ability to architect and troubleshoot complex environments.
  • Exceptional ability to present complex technical concepts to a wide range of audiences—from deeply technical developer teams to executive-level (CISO, CTO) stakeholders.
  • Be passionate in regard to continuous self-improvement and learning to maintain technical leadership.
  • Full professional fluency in Swedish (both written and verbal)

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as the company's top field expert in application and cloud-native security and provide technical and business-relevant feedback into Product Management based on field engagements to improve Wiz’s position and value messaging to prospects and clients.
  • Collaborate with Wiz sales teams on strategic opportunities in demonstrating the business and technical value of the Wiz platform.
  • Assist SEs and prospects during the POC process with advanced use cases, installation/deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • Lead regular thought leadership sessions with the field teams sharing insights and approaches derived through customer engagement to improve our effectiveness in messaging and delivering value to prospective clients and existing customers.
  • Assist in messaging and selling Wiz platform capabilities to prospects and customers.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need forvisa sponsorship.This role does not offervisasponsorship.

Position Summary:

The Specialty Inside Sales Representative is responsible for engaging health care professionals (HCPs) in telephone conversations and live interactions to promote assigned client product(s), maximize the product(s)’ selling potential and meet program and Client objectives. The Specialty Inside Sales Rep achieves this by developing and maintaining relationships with HCPs and by educating them about product features, benefits, safety profile and approved indications to ensure appropriate patient use. The Specialty Inside Sales Rep utilizes approved tools for product and program promotion and maintains a competent level of product, program and customer activity knowledge.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily sales call activity according to defined expectations, with the purpose of influencing customers and increasing product sales.

  • Strong rapport building skills and active listening skills.

  • Ability to display high-levels of initiative, effort and commitment successfully complete projects and assignments.

  • Ability to comprehend and communicate complex technical/medical terminology and to maintain the required technical expertise including competitive product knowledge.

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit team protects Stripe by managing the end-to-end risk of our largest and most complex users. We leverage deep underwriting expertise and data-driven stress heuristics to make informed decisions at every stage of the user lifecycle—from onboarding to loss recovery. Our goal is to enable Stripe’s growth by making confident, calibrated decisions on our highest-exposure users.

What you’ll do

Stripe handles billions of dollars every year for businesses around the world, and the Risk team plays a critical role in the company’s financial and partnership success. As a Credit Analyst Underwriter on the North America Strategy Risk team, you will underwrite and manage a portfolio of our largest and fastest growing businesses in order to facilitate Stripe’s growth objectives while minimizing Stripe’s credit risk. This is a high impact role that involves strong cross-functional partnership with Sales, Legal, Treasury, and Finance.

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with our top merchants, from successful venture-backed startups to well-established institutions, to evaluate their business models and financial statements.
  • Provide tailored credit risk recommendations that mitigate Stripe's exposure, while facilitating partner company growth.
  • Help manage the portfolio by developing a deep understanding of risk across industries, geographies, and operating models.
  • Deliver insights to support senior management decisions, ranging from onboarding strategies to merchant pricing analysis.
  • Support the refinement of tools and processes to help the team deliver on key performance indicators, such as credit loss targets or portfolio coverage metrics.
  • Work with internal and external partners to support merchants around the world.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant experience with knowledge of commercial credit underwriting, financial risk modeling, and cash flow forecasting
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or other related fields
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and comfort evaluating financial statements and business models across a range of industries
  • Ability to transform business and financial data into cohesive narratives that outline potential credit risks and present dynamic mitigation strategies
  • Strong written, verbal, and analytical skills
  • Attention to detail while managing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to comfortably interact with the CFOs and CEOs of our top merchants
  • Deep empathy for entrepreneurs running a business and motivation to solve problems to empower them

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong technical expertise, including demonstrated experience with SQL
  • Strong data visualization skills and a passion for data and analysis
  • Experience working in tech or other fast-paced, high-growth environments

raw.description:
The Role:

We are looking for a full-time seasoned Customer Success Lead to own, grow, and protect the commercial relationships within our high-touch customer base. This is a player-coach role: you will directly manage a Book of Business (BoB) of up to 50 accounts representing approximately ~$4M in total annual Google Workspace spend, while also leading our Solutions team for tactical/low-touch initiatives.

You will be the person our highest-value clients — Directors, VPs, Procurement leads, and C-Suite executives — trust as a strategic partner. Your primary mandate is ensuring clients renew, expand, and view us as an indispensable part of their Google ecosystem.

Alongside that, you will be expected to drive Gemini and Google Cloud adoption, execute on expansion opportunities, and develop the playbooks that scale our CS motion across the organization.

This role is distinct from a traditional Customer Success Manager or Key Account Manager. You will carry a full-cycle commercial motion — onboarding, retention, and upsell — while simultaneously building the systems, segmentation, and coaching cadence that allow your Solutions team to handle the tactical, low-touch layer.

Responsibilities:

  • Account Management & Retention

    • Own a BoB of up to 50 accounts (high-touch), representing ~$4M in total annual Google Workspace spend.

    • Drive contract renewals end-to-end, including multi-year Google Workspace agreements and Google product expansions.

    • Develop and maintain executive relationships at the Director, VP, and C-Suite level across your accounts.

    • Segment your portfolio by churn risk, growth potential, and strategic value — adjusting your cadence accordingly.

    • Maintain a target Net Revenue Retention (NRR) of ≥110% and < 8% churn rate annually across your BoB.

  • Growth & Expansion

    • Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities including Gemini Enterprise, additional Google Workspace SKUs, and Google Cloud services.

    • Lead a Solutions team and collaborate with Sales to develop account expansion plans tied to QBRs and annual reviews.

    • Actively position Gemini AI features and Google Cloud capabilities during client engagements as part of our value proposition.

  • Onboarding & Product Adoption

    • Lead high-touch onboarding experiences for new and migrated clients, ensuring rapid time-to-value.

    • Drive product adoption across Google Workspace, monitoring usage signals to intervene proactively with at-risk accounts.

    • Build educational materials, training sessions, and adoption playbooks for Gemini and Workspace best practices.

  • Team Leadership

    • After a 90-day onboarding period, take ownership of the Solutions team, with direct reports transitioning to you.

    • Coach and delegate tactical/low-touch account management to your Solutions team, freeing your capacity for strategic high-touch work.

    • Establish clear KPIs, SLAs, and workflows for the combined CS + Solutions Success motion.

  • Operations & Tooling

    • Maintain a clean, up-to-date CRM pipeline across all accounts and contacts in your BoB.

    • Report on key CS metrics weekly and prepare executive summaries for leadership reviews.

    • Partner with the Director of Operations to refine CS SOPs, health scoring models, and renewal workflows.

Requirements:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a full-cycle Customer Success, Account Management, or Commercial AM role — you have owned renewals, driven upsells, and managed a real book of business with ARR targets.

  • You are genuinely client-facing. You are comfortable and confident in front of C-level executives, VPs, and Procurement teams — over video, in writing, and in live strategy sessions.

  • You think commercially. You understand the difference between a support interaction and a revenue conversation, and you know how to navigate both.

  • You are organized and process-driven. You thrive when managing a high-volume portfolio and have a system for triaging urgency, tracking your pipeline, and staying ahead of churn signals.

  • You are a leader-in-the-making (or already one). You are comfortable mentoring, delegating, and being accountable for a small team's output.

  • You write exceptionally well in English. Client communications should require minimal editing. You know how to strike the right tone with an executive vs. a technical lead.

  • You are curious about AI in the context of real business workflows. You understand or can quickly learn how Gemini integrates with Google Workspace and why that matters to a leadership team.

  • You are self-directed and proactive. You identify what needs to happen next before being asked, and you follow through.

  • Google Workspace familiarity is a strong plus. A GWS Admin or GCP certification, or demonstrable product knowledge, meaningfully reduces ramp up time.

WHO WE ARE

Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.

We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

We have offices in the US, London and Germany. Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, Planet Fitness, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.

OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Supervisor, Marketing Science & Analytics to join Redbox, Crossmedia’s marketing science and data science team. You will serve as a day-to-day analytical lead across client engagements, new business opportunities, and internal initiatives, partnering closely with Analysts, Engineers, Directors, and cross-functional agency teams.

This role combines hands-on statistical and data science expertise with client leadership, team management, and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear, actionable insights.

YOUR ROLE

  • Lead marketing science and analytics workstreams across current clients, new business, and internal initiatives, managing projects from data and measurement through analysis, insights, and recommendations.
  • Partner directly with clients and account teams to define measurement objectives, translate business questions into testable hypotheses, and develop rigorous analytical approaches.
  • Apply statistical and data science methods including media mix modeling (MMM), regression, causal inference, experimentation, geo-lift/DMA holdout testing, Bayesian methods, segmentation, forecasting, and optimization.
  • Build, interpret, and communicate statistical models and translate complex analyses into compelling, actionable stories for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Use Python and SQL to analyze data and build reproducible, well-documented analytical workflows; experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery is preferred.
  • Develop dashboards, visualizations, and other data products using tools such as Tableau, Python visualization libraries, or Datorama.
  • Manage analytical delivery and execution with external measurement and data partners.
  • Serve as a trusted statistical and marketing science expert in client meetings, confidently explaining methodology, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
  • Ensure analytical work is statistically rigorous, reproducible, and meets XM’s standards for quality.
  • Lead and mentor Analysts and Data Scientists, providing guidance on prioritization, analytical approaches, coding practices, and professional development.
  • Keep Directors and account teams informed of project progress, risks, and key decisions, escalating issues and seeking senior support when appropriate.
  • Contribute to the development of Redbox’s marketing science and data science capabilities through training, thought leadership, technical content, and new methodologies.
  • Participate in broader team and agency initiatives, including talent development, recruiting, vendor management, and department planning.
  • Stay current on emerging statistical, data science, and marketing measurement approaches and adapt as Redbox’s tools and capabilities evolve.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing science, statistics, econometrics, data science, or another quantitative discipline; media or advertising experience is a plus.
  • Strong foundation in statistics and hands-on experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
  • Proficiency in Python, with experience using tools such as pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, PyMC, Meridian, or similar.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets; cloud data warehouse experience preferred.
  • Experience with marketing measurement, including MMM, incrementality, experimentation, causal inference, or related methodologies.
  • Ability to independently manage analytical workstreams and client relationships while knowing when to bring in senior leadership.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or developing junior team members.
  • Curiosity, sound analytical judgment, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, evolving environment and move comfortably between client work, new business, and internal initiatives.

CROSSMEDIA BENEFITS

Our principles of Trust, Reason, and the Pursuit of Happiness are brought to life through benefits that recognize and support the diversity and physical, emotional, and professional well-being of our people, including:

  • Flexibility to work in hybrid manner with in-office and work from home options (depending on role).
  • Open/Flexible PTO/Annual leave with US & UK specific policies
  • Sponsored healthcare options and agency-wide physical & mental health support
  • 401k with company match (USA), and generous Pension (UK)
  • Paid sabbatical at significant milestone anniversaries
  • Generous paid parental leave policy
  • Life milestone recognition & support
  • The Pursuit of Happiness Fund devoted to helping Crossmedians find their happy (be it travel, enrichment class, fitness membership or professional development)
  • Cell phone/tech reimbursement
  • Student Loan payment plan (US)
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Learning & Development and training programs
  • And burgers – lots and lots of burgers

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Diversity is in our DNA. As a minority-owned company, our commitment to an inclusive environment has long been embedded into agency practices and at every level. Almost one third of senior leadership identifies as a person of color and over half of our executive leadership are women. We have active mentoring & internship programs that create opportunities for underrepresented groups. Internal agency programming is anchored by XMEquity365, a permanent, year-round initiative fostering acknowledgement and support of marginalized communities within five pillars – Excellence, Voices, Education, Giving & Representation.

Crossmedia is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and creating a diverse and inclusive company culture and that does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.

All job requirements are subject to possible revision to reflect changes in the position requirements, business necessities and/or to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Essential and other job functions are subject to modification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to which will be required in this position. Employees will be required to follow other job-related duties as requested by their supervisor/manager (within guidelines and compliance with laws in the US and UK ).

Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.” Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions in compliance with the American with Disabilities Act of 1990 (US based)

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

raw.excerpt: Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
raw.description:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking a: OEM Partnerships Manager!

About the Role:

Backblaze closed CoreWeave at $335M TCV. The NeoCloud flywheel is moving — but it stalls without validated reference architectures embedded at the silicon and systems layer.

This role owns Pillar 1: getting B2 designed-in at NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Cerebras, and the OEM/ODM tier (Super Micro, WD, Seagate) so that every GPU cluster configured for AI inference or training has B2 as the default object storage layer. At the same time we want to build the Storage Tiers from Flash (VAST, WEKA, DDN) to Object Store on HDD with Backblaze. You are the person who makes Backblaze the storage answer before a customer ever talks to a sales rep.

What You’ll Do:

Designed-In at the Silicon Layer

  • Establish and advance Backblaze B2 as a validated storage tier within NVIDIA's AI Data Platform ecosystem — CUDA-integrated, reference-architecture-certified.
  • Drive "Design-In" motions with AMD (Instinct reference stack) and Intel (Gaudi/Xeon roadmap) to close the gap opened by VAST Data's current AMD Instinct reference architecture position.
  • Build relationships with Cerebras, SambaNova, and emerging xPU vendors early enough to be designed into their validated stacks before competitive displacement occurs.

OEM & ODM Tier

  • Own the joint go-to-market with Super Micro (SMCI), WD, and Seagate — turning their hardware deployments into B2-integrated solutions sold as complete infrastructure.
  • Extend these relationships to the Flash Tier - VAST, WEKA & DDN in particular
  • Structure OEM agreements and co-sell motions that create pull-through B2 ARR from hardware-first deals. Build the commercial model (referral, resell, or embedded) for each OEM tier.
  • Identify and close 2–3 new OEM/ODM partnerships per year that generate $10M+ in partner-influenced ARR within the first 6 months.

Turnkey Reference Architectures

  • Deliver 5+ published, co-branded reference architectures by end of FY2026 — pairing GPU compute configurations with B2 as the validated storage layer.
  • Work with the NeoCloud team (Field CTO & BD lead) and DevRel Lead on Flamethrower to produce technical validation content that serves both the partner and the end customer.
  • Ensure reference architectures are submitted to and accepted by Tier-1 analyst firms (2 published analyst reports is a FY2026 OKR.

FY2026 OKR Accountability — Pillar 1

  • Contribute to the $10M TCV OEM-ISV related bookings OKR through OEM-influenced pipeline.
  • Deliver Reference #1 NVIDIA AI Data Platform & OEM (AMD/Intel) co-marketing as Reference #2.
  • Support the 5-of-Top-25 OEM-ISV account close target through OEM-sourced intros and designed-in positions.

Cross-Functional

  • Partner with AEs to convert OEM-designed (powered by) in positions into sourced pipeline.
  • Feed product roadmap gaps (cold storage tier, archive, to Product & Engineering
  • Coordinate with SE (Reference Architectures) so every OEM co-development produces a publishable, reusable asset.

The Right Fit:

Required

  • 10+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or OEM/ODM business development — preferably in cloud infrastructure, storage, or AI systems.
  • Existing relationships at NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, or a major GPU OEM (SMCI, WD, Seagate, Quanta, or equivalent). You know who owns the ecosystem programs and you can get a meeting.
  • Experience structuring and closing OEM agreements — referral, resell, embedded, or co-sell — with a track record of partner-influenced ARR.
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML infrastructure: you understand GPU cluster architecture, storage tiering, CUDA/software stacks, and how storage fits into training and inference workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive reference architecture co-development — from whiteboard to published, co-branded technical validation.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce for partner pipeline tracking and forecasting.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience working inside or alongside NVIDIA's AI Data Platform, AMD Instinct, or Intel Gaudi partner programs.
  • Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage in AI data pipeline contexts (training data ingestion, checkpoint storage, inference output).
  • Background at a cloud storage, IaaS, or AI infrastructure vendor (not hyperscaler — we are explicitly the non-AWS/GCP/Azure option).
  • Existing relationships at Cerebras, SambaNova, or other emerging xPU vendors is a significant differentiator.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You need a mature partner program handed to you — this is a build role. The ref arch playbook exists for CoreWeave; you are extending it to the OEM tier.
  • You lead with slide decks instead of relationships — the first 90 days are relationship mapping and meeting cadences, not program documentation.
  • You are not comfortable with technical conversations at the SE/architect level — OEM partners will disqualify you fast if you cannot hold the storage-in-AI-systems discussion.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience running an AI program across multiple functions simultaneously
  • Familiarity with AI governance in data-sensitive or PII-adjacent environments
  • Background in cloud infrastructure, storage, or technical B2B businesses
  • Exposure to org transitions - restructures, outsourcing programs, distributed team ramp-ups - and the workflow documentation challenges they create

Logistics

  • Remote US · Prefer West Coast or Texas (proximity to NVIDIA HQ Santa Clara, AMD Austin, SMCI San Jose)
  • 30-50% travel · NAB, SC25, GTC, partner QBRs
  • Reports to: Sr. Director, Partnerships & Ecosystem (when filled) or directly to CRO in interim

Backblaze Perks:

  • Healthcare for family, including dental and vision
  • Competitive compensation and 401K
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base pay range for this position is $134,400 - $164,500.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Location: Remote – South Africa
Sector: Technology & Finance
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 09:00–17:00 UK time, Monday to Friday

Role Overview

Our client is a specialist UK-based executive search consultancy operating across the Technology and Finance sectors. They are seeking an experienced and polished Senior Executive Search Resourcer to support senior-level and executive search assignments across the UK, Europe and the United States.

This role is focused on identifying, engaging and qualifying high-calibre professionals at Director, VP, C-suite and senior leadership level.

This is not a high-volume recruitment or CV sourcing position. The successful candidate will be expected to take a highly targeted, research-led and consultative approach to executive search. You will build detailed market maps, approach passive candidates with credibility, conduct meaningful qualification conversations and develop long-term relationships with senior professionals.

You will work closely with Executive Search Consultants and Partners, providing high-quality candidate intelligence, market insight and research throughout the search lifecycle.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

  • Identify and headhunt senior-level candidates across specialist Technology and Finance markets.
  • Conduct detailed market mapping to identify relevant companies, teams, leadership structures and potential candidates.
  • Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, internal databases and targeted research.
  • Engage passive candidates at Director, VP, C-suite and executive level in a professional and credible manner.
  • Conduct detailed candidate qualification and screening calls.
  • Assess candidates based on experience, leadership capability, career motivations, compensation expectations and future objectives.
  • Build a strong understanding of each candidate's professional background and suitability for specific executive search assignments.
  • Present well-qualified and accurately documented candidate profiles to the Executive Search Consultant or Partner.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior professionals, rather than engaging candidates solely for immediate vacancies.
  • Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the search process.
  • Gather market intelligence relating to organisational structures, senior appointments, leadership movements and competitor activity.
  • Identify potential commercial intelligence and business development opportunities uncovered through candidate conversations and market research.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, notes, search activity and follow-up actions within the ATS and CRM.
  • Support the preparation of candidate reports, market maps, longlists, shortlists and search documentation.
  • Assist with interview coordination and candidate management throughout the recruitment process.
  • Provide ongoing market feedback to Consultants regarding candidate availability, compensation trends and market sentiment.
  • Contribute to the continuous development of the firm's candidate network across Technology and Finance.

Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate should have:

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience within executive search, permanent recruitment, recruitment research or senior-level resourcing.
  • Proven experience sourcing and engaging Director, VP, C-suite or other senior-level professionals.
  • Previous experience working within executive search or a highly targeted headhunting environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience recruiting internationally, ideally across the UK, Europe and/or United States.
  • Strong market mapping and candidate research skills.
  • Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates.
  • Excellent candidate qualification and consultative interviewing skills.
  • Confidence discussing senior-level career moves, motivations, compensation and leadership experience.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility with senior professionals.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how candidate conversations can generate useful market and business intelligence.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms and CRM systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate candidate documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple executive search assignments simultaneously.
  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with the wider search team.

Technology & Finance Market Exposure

Experience recruiting within one or more of the following areas would be advantageous:

Technology

  • Software and SaaS
  • FinTech
  • Data and Analytics
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud and Infrastructure
  • Digital Transformation
  • Technology Leadership
  • Product and Engineering
  • IT Services and Consulting

Finance

  • Financial Services
  • Banking
  • Private Equity
  • Investment Management
  • FinTech
  • Corporate Finance
  • Accounting and Finance Leadership
  • Risk and Compliance
  • Insurance
  • CFO and senior finance leadership appointments

Candidates do not necessarily need experience across both Technology and Finance, provided they have strong executive search expertise within a relevant specialist market.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Professional, polished and credible when communicating with senior executives.
  • Naturally inquisitive and comfortable asking detailed questions.
  • Consultative rather than transactional in their approach.
  • Confident speaking with Director, VP and C-suite professionals.
  • Skilled at building trust and developing long-term candidate relationships.
  • Comfortable challenging candidates and thoroughly assessing their suitability.
  • Commercially aware and able to recognise valuable market intelligence.
  • Research-driven and able to understand complex organisational structures and specialist markets.
  • Persistent and confident when approaching passive candidates.
  • Highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
  • Detail-oriented when recording candidate and market information.
  • Focused on delivering quality rather than volume.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of search assignments.
  • Motivated by working within a high-quality executive search environment.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • The quality and relevance of candidates identified.
  • Ability to engage difficult-to-reach senior professionals.
  • Quality and depth of candidate qualification.
  • Accuracy and completeness of market mapping.
  • Strength of candidate relationships developed over time.
  • Quality of candidate profiles presented to Consultants and Partners.
  • Consistency of candidate follow-up and pipeline management.
  • Quality of market intelligence gathered.
  • Contribution to successful executive search assignments.
  • Accuracy of ATS and CRM records.
  • Ability to identify potential commercial opportunities through market conversations.

Benefits

Working Requirements

  • Full-time position.
  • Monday to Friday.
  • 09:00–17:00 UK time.
  • Fully remote from South Africa.
  • Reliable internet connection and professional home-working environment required.
  • Regular telephone and video conversations with senior candidates across international markets will form a core part of the role.

Job Description

In this role you will be joining a team of technical professionals supporting a large-scale z/OS systems platform. This position requires an experienced systems programmer with at least 3 years of experience supporting the z/OS Mainframe Network environment. Responsibilities include configuring and maintaining the integrity and data/IP security of the Mainframe's host communication subsystems and associated program products.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Being part of a multi-functional team, supporting IBM mainframe networks and transmissions products and infrastructure.
  • Participation in support rota providing 24x7 cover.
  • Perform TCPIP Port Reserves (Additions, Deletions, Changes) Perform VTAM updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes)
  • Manage OSA Adapters in a complex mainframe environment
  • Perform VTAM PU/LU updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes) including Enterprise Extenders (EE)
  • Implement AT-TLS rules (digital certificate management). Configure and manage IPSEC policies (permit/deny rules, VPN- ipsec tunnels)
  • Trace, Debug and Error Analysis
  • Communicate regularly with technical, applications and operational staff to ensure Network connectivity and security (may involve some after hours and weekend work)

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Experience of working as a z/OS Systems Specialist in the IT industry of over 10+ years

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in administering file transmissions products such as Connect:Direct and FTP, or alternatively good experience as a user of these products.
  • Knowledge of z/OS and z/OS utilities.
  • Understanding of z/OS networking services, structure and related software and protocols.
  • Understanding of network security disciplines (IPSec, TLS/SSL, certificates, etc) and how they relate to file transmission.
  • Experience of problem management from initial diagnosis through to resolution.
  • Understanding of the Change Management process.
  • Ability to customize and manage secure SNA and TCP/IP networks under z/OS.
  • Knowledge of mainframe network management tools, e.g. NetMaster, and multi-session manager products such as TUBES and Supersession.
  • Experience of managing mainframe printing products.
  • General z/OS systems programming experience.
  • Knowledge of System z hardware including the OSA-Express network cards.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Good communication, teamwork and negotiation skills
  • Familiarity with the Cisco Network Solutions
  • The ability to work to tight deadlines under pressure
  • Good organisational skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability
  • The ability to create and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues and customers
  • Business awareness and understanding of business requirements of IT
  • A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology
  • An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act.

raw.description:
Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

At CompanyCam, the Sr. Director of Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data owns the architecture, administration, and roadmap of our MarTech stack, our marketing data strategy, and the paid and owned digital channel strategy that stack is built to support. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing and serving on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team, you'll build and lead a Marketing Operations team responsible for Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, Webflow, and our ad platform stack, and lead a website development team with real engineers and engineering process.

This is a hands-on technical leader, not a generalist who manages people who understand the tools better than they do. You should be equally comfortable evaluating an integration decision, setting channel mix strategy, and translating marketing data into recommendations for the SLT.

Location: Remote - Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Own the MarTech roadmap and architecture across Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, Webflow, and the ad platform stack, defining how systems integrate and how data flows end to end
  • Build and lead a Marketing Operations team that administers and governs the MarTech stack, and co-owns Webflow with the Web/Brand team
  • Own the integrated paid and owned digital channel strategy, setting channel mix, investment priorities, and performance targets
  • Own CompanyCam's marketing data strategy, including the data model and data integrity across Marketing's systems
  • Lead the marketing website development team, owning the engineering roadmap, sprint process, and release/QA process for the marketing site
  • Lead and develop the Director of Growth Operations, Sr. Marketing Optimization Manager, Marketing Operations team, and website development team
  • Serve as the Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data voice on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems, and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you'll drive impact by:

  • Building a MarTech architecture and marketing data strategy that scales with the business instead of constraining it
  • Leading a real engineering function for the marketing website, raising code quality and release discipline
  • Setting a digital channel strategy that connects investment directly to pipeline and acquisition outcomes
  • Giving the Marketing SLT a technical and data-driven voice they can act on
  • Developing directors and senior managers into stronger, more autonomous leaders

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years in digital marketing, marketing technology, or marketing operations leadership, including 5+ years directly owning a MarTech stack and leading technical or operations teams in B2B SaaS or high-growth technology
  • Proven, hands-on ownership of core MarTech platforms: Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, and Webflow, including administration, architecture, and integration decisions
  • Experience leading a website development function, including engineering process and technical site architecture, not just content or design oversight
  • Deep understanding of marketing data architecture: data models, integrations, APIs, and ETL/automation tools like Workato, , Hightouch, or Zapier
  • Demonstrated expertise developing integrated digital channel strategies across paid and owned channels
  • Proven ability to partner with analytics and data engineering teams on measurement frameworks and attribution models
  • Experience managing agency and vendor relationships for paid media and web development
  • Experience evaluating and optimizing team operating models, including in-house vs. outsourced resourcing

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $195,000-$225,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

raw.description:
About the Client
Our client is a distribution company with nearly 20 years of experience selling brand-name products through major ecommerce marketplaces, including Amazon and eBay. They are now expanding their operations into the Walmart Marketplace (walmart.ca) and are looking to build out a dedicated function to support this growth. The company has a proven track record of successfully working with remote assistants and is looking to bring on specialized talent as part of that continued expansion.
Why does this role exist?
As the client expands into the Walmart Marketplace, they lack the internal time and platform-specific expertise to manage this channel effectively on their own. This role exists to fill that gap immediately — the client needs someone who can independently manage day-to-day Walmart Marketplace operations from day one, with no ramp-up or training required. The mission of this role is to help the client grow a healthy, well-managed Walmart sales channel by keeping inventory flowing, issues resolved, and processes documented as the business scales.

The Impact you’ll make

Sell-Through Performance Monitoring
  • Monitor daily and weekly sell-through performance on Walmart Marketplace
  • Identify trends or anomalies in sales velocity and flag them proactively
  • Track key account health metrics on the platform
Inventory Replenishment Management
  • Review warehouse inventory levels on an ongoing basis
  • Prepare replenishment orders and submit for approval
  • Apply inventory turns and replenishment logic to avoid stockouts or overstock
Shipment Creation Logistics
  • Create and manage shipments to Walmart fulfillment/warehouse locations
  • Ensure shipments are accurate, timely, and compliant with Walmart's requirements
Stale Inventory Issue Resolution
  • Monitor for slow-moving or stale inventory and take appropriate action (recall stock, run ads, or escalate to the Walmart rep)
  • Open and manage support cases when issues arise on the platform
  • Troubleshoot day-to-day platform issues independently
Process Systems Development
  • Help build and document repeatable systems and SOPs over time
  • Continuously refine workflows as the Walmart channel matures

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing a seller account on Walmart Marketplace (Seller Center)
  • Demonstrated ability to open, manage, and resolve platform support cases independently
  • Experience with inventory management and replenishment processes in an ecommerce context
  • Comfortable creating and managing shipments to a marketplace platform
  • Available to work Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm EST, full-time (40 hrs/week)
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical:
    - Deep, working knowledge of Walmart Marketplace/Seller Center navigation and functionality
    - Understanding of inventory turns, stock forecasting, and replenishment logic
    - Experience with ecommerce marketplace operations more broadly (Amazon, eBay, or similar, is a plus)
    - Strong analytical skills for interpreting sell-through and inventory data
    - Process documentation and SOP creation
  • Soft skills:
    - Highly self-directed with strong ownership of tasks — comfortable operating with minimal oversight
    - Proactive problem-solver who escalates issues before they become bigger problems
    - Detail-oriented, especially around inventory numbers and shipment accuracy
    - Clear, organized communicator
    - Adaptable to evolving priorities as the Walmart channel scales
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You thrive when given ownership over a channel and don't need to be told what "good" looks like — you already know because you've done this before.
  • You're the type of person who notices a slow-moving SKU before anyone asks, and you'd rather solve a platform issue yourself than wait for direction.
  • You care about getting the details right (inventory counts, shipment accuracy, case follow-ups) because you understand how much those small things affect the bigger picture.
  • You're comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous-friendly environment, but you also value building solid systems and documentation so the work outlives any one person doing it.
What to expect...
Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • Monday–Friday, 9:00 am–5:00 pm Eastern Time
Compensation:
  • $7 per hour
  • No benefits package included

As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro is seeking a strategic and detail-oriented GTM Commission Manager to lead the design, transformation, and administration of our commission programs. Reporting to the Sales Operations leader within the Revenue Operations organization, this role will own the end-to-end commission strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with GTM goals, accuracy in payouts, and scalability as the business evolves. The ideal candidate will drive program consolidation, implement best practices, and ensure a seamless transition to scalable tooling and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Finance, Payroll, HR, and GTM Operations to ensure smooth and compliant commission execution.
  • Provide ongoing visibility into attainment, payout trends, and plan performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field required; MBA or related advanced degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Compensation, Revenue Operations, or a related GTM function, preferably within a SaaS environment.

raw.description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Senior Permitting Manager to join our Commercial Real Estate team working remotely, based in the Central or Western US. In this role, you will lead the strategic development and execution of our site permitting program, balancing tactical delivery with forward-looking regulatory strategy. You will own complex, cross-functional initiatives that directly impact team-level key results and Wing’s broader commercial success. The successful candidate is intrinsically driven to solve complex problems, challenge the status quo, and build elegant, scalable processes. You will act as a key leader and subject matter expert, guiding peers and influencing external municipalities to achieve Wing Nest permitting milestones. To support these on-the-ground advocacy efforts, this position requires up to 75% travel, including occasional international trips.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead end-to-end permitting initiatives across multiple jurisdictions. Define goals, operational plans, and success metrics that align directly with Wing’s commercial and financial objectives.
  • Actively shape the regulatory landscape. Identify key municipal decision-makers, build compelling business cases, and thoughtfully partner with them to align on project objectives and advance Wing’s strategic interests.
  • Architect unified work scopes by delegating to and collaborating with internal engineering teams, design professionals, and external Wing Partners. Resolve conflicts and areas of misalignment to keep projects moving smoothly.
  • Apply a strong analytical mindset to test assumptions, forecast potential regulatory bottlenecks, and enact robust contingency plans before challenges escalate into major obstacles.
  • Continuously challenge the status quo. Identify opportunities to optimize the permitting process, implement test-and-learn approaches, and champion change management internally to accelerate our deployment speed.
  • Model a commitment to continuous improvement. Share your subject matter expertise proactively, guide peers through complex challenges, and build systems that make the process better and more efficient for the next person.
  • Up to 75% travel, including occasional international trips.

What You’ll Need:

  • 8+ years of strategic experience securing construction, land use, and ordinance-based site permits, with a proven track record of scaling a permitting program across multiple complex jurisdictions.
  • Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Demonstrated ability to link operational permitting decisions to broader business impact and financial goals.
  • Established relationships with municipalities (or the proven ability to rapidly build them), with exceptional skills in negotiating, communicating goals, and driving cross-functional adoption of your ideas.
  • Proficiency in interpreting CAD site design systems and site plans, using this knowledge to test data, address engineering challenges, and inform long-term project decisions.
