raw.description:
About Get Covered & Revyse

We provide cost-effective coverage with just a few clicks — satisfying residents, property managers, agencies, and distribution partners with a process that is as simple and touchless as possible.

Revyse helps multifamily operators discover the best vendor partners, manage

contracts and compliance, and reduce financial risk. Our platform turns vendor data

into a strategic advantage - and our newest compliance product is changing how

property management companies onboard, verify, and support vendors.

We’re a fast-moving post-acquisition startup with a big vision: overhaul how

operators and suppliers work together. Founded by industry experts and backed by

leading multifamily investors, Revyse is growing quickly - and we’re looking for

someone who loves building order from the chaos of growth.

About the role

Worth knowing before you apply, because you will meet all of it in your first month.

You support pods, not a single manager's queue. Product managers and engineers

are both your customers, and they will want different things on the same day. So will

real customers!

You have no authority to assign work. Nobody here does. Your influence comes

entirely from the quality of your context and the clarity of your case, which is either

the best part of this job or the wrong job for you.

The domain has depth and complexity. Insurance requirements vary by trade, scope

of work, and state. Compliance rules vary by customer. You will not be able to reason

about our data without learning the domain, and we will give you time to learn it.

Our documentation is uneven. Some things are written down. Many are not, and

finding out is the work rather than a blocker to it.

We are a small company post-acquisition and still forming. Your work is visible, and

so are the gaps you close.

What you'll do

If AI drafts the tickets, the quality of what gets built is decided by the context it

receives. That context is what you’ll optimize.

Understand and write down how the platform actually behaves today - the

workflows, the exception paths, the rules, and the undocumented behavior currently

living in people's heads.

Build and maintain the reference material that our AI tooling and our engineers pull

from, and keep it accurate as the product changes. Stale documentation now

produces bad tickets and bad code automatically, at scale.

Review tickets and specs against reality before anyone builds them. This is the part

that matters most: AI-generated work is confidently wrong exactly where it costs the

most - edge cases, compliance rules, customer-specific commitments, anything that

is not in the repo or the training data.

Capture acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure behavior, and explicit non-goals so a

pod can pick something up and build it without a meeting.

Qualifications

3+ years as a business analyst, technical analyst, product analyst, data analyst,

or in product operations, working closely with engineers.

● Strong SQL. You write your own queries against a real schema, you

understand what a join is doing to your row count, and you sanity-check your

results before presenting them.

● You can read a database schema and work out how a product behaves from it.

● You already work with AI as a daily tool, not an experiment. You know how to

structure context so output is reliable, you iterate on prompts rather than

accepting the first answer, and you know when a model is confidently wrong

and you check.

● You can build a rough working thing with AI assistance. Not production code.

A prototype good enough that people can react to it instead of imagining it.

● You write clearly. In a setup like ours, written clarity is not a soft skill. It is the

input that determines what gets built.

● Analytical honesty. You quantify rather than characterize, you name your

assumptions, and when numbers don't reconcile you stop and investigate

instead of shipping the chart.

● Comfort operating without process scaffolding, and comfort saying “not this

week, here's why” when three people want the same hour.

  • Bonus: B2B SaaS with enterprise customers, compliance- or workflow-heavy

products, Python for analysis, or experience maintaining documentation that

AI tooling depends on.

raw.description:
Striim, (pronounced “stream” with two i’s for integration and intelligence), is a unified data integration and streaming platform that connects clouds, data, and applications with unprecedented speed and simplicity to deliver the right data at the right time. Striim is used by enterprise companies to monitor events across any environment, build applications that drive digital transformation, and leverage true real-time analytics to provide a superior experience to their customers. At our company, we believe and expect all of our employees to operate as one with unlimited potential and dignity.

About the Role

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to report to our Field CTO within the Engineering organization. This is a highly strategic and tactical, customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of customer success and technical excellence. You will partner with enterprise clients across the entire customer lifecycle—from pre-sales discovery and solution architecture through post-sales adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term success.

While customer-facing, this is fundamentally a technical engineering position. You will spend 40-50% of your time writing code, architecting solutions, debugging complex distributed systems, and building production-grade integrations. The remaining time is spent collaborating with customers and internal teams to ensure technical success and business outcomes. You will serve as both a principal-level technical leader and a trusted customer advocate, ensuring our platform delivers measurable business value while shaping the future direction of our product.

You will work closely with Sales & Field Engineering, Product, and Technical Account Management teams to architect and deliver complex, real-time data solutions across modern cloud and AI-driven ecosystems. This role requires up to 50% travel and a strong commitment to building deep, long-lasting customer relationships through consistent engagement.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Implementation

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of real-time data pipelines using CDC, Kafka, and related technologies; architect multi-cloud data solutions (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Build custom connectors, integrations, and production-grade systems using Java and Python; architect APIs and data pipelines
  • Design and optimize Kubernetes deployments and containerized data workloads for performance, cost, and reliability
  • Debug and resolve complex technical issues across distributed systems, including backend, infrastructure, and data layers
  • Create reusable Java/Python libraries, frameworks, and solution accelerators to extend impact across customer implementations
  • Conduct technical code reviews, architecture assessments, and deep-dive technical sessions with customer engineering teams

Customer Partnership & Solution Architecture

  • Serve as the primary technical partner to customers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales discovery and solution architecture through post-sales adoption, expansion, and renewal
  • Partner with Sales and Field Engineering to design and architect complex, enterprise-grade solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with customer stakeholders through ongoing engagement, including on-site meetings and industry events
  • Act as the technical point of escalation for customer challenges, ensuring timely resolution and continued success
  • Design solutions for performance, scalability, and reliability in production environments at enterprise scale (100GB+/day throughput)

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Influence

  • Act as the voice of the customer, capturing insights and translating them into clear, actionable product requirements
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities and future feature development
  • Translate business needs into highly technical concepts, bridging communication between customers and internal teams
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Field Engineering, Product, and Technical Account Management to deliver a seamless and unified customer experience
  • Contribute to internal best practices, documentation, and scalable solution frameworks

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Field Engineer, Cloud Architect, or similar)
  • Proven ability to own and deliver across the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sales through post-sales success
  • Deep technical expertise with the ability to operate at a senior or principal level, including solution architecture and hands-on implementation

Programming & Development

  • Expert-level proficiency in Java and/or Python, with the ability to architect and implement production-grade systems
  • Proficiency in at least one language required; proficiency in both highly valued
  • Strong experience building distributed systems, APIs, and enterprise integrations
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)

Cloud & Data Ecosystem

  • Deep experience with multi-cloud environments: AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3), GCP (Dataflow, BigQuery), and/or Azure (Synapse, Event Hubs)
  • Expertise in real-time data streaming and data integration:
    • Change Data Capture (CDC) technologies
    • Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming
    • Event-driven architectures
  • Strong background with modern data platforms:
    • Data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, PostgreSQL)
    • Kubernetes and distributed systems
    • AI/ML frameworks and analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Spark)
  • Experience optimizing system performance and reliability at scale

Communication & Problem-Solving

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to:
    • Translate complex technical concepts into business value for customers
    • Convert business needs into clear technical requirements for product teams
    • Present technical solutions to both engineering and executive stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous, high-impact environments
  • Ability to mentor customer engineering teams and share technical expertise

Travel & Commitment

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%
  • Commitment to building deep, long-lasting customer relationships through consistent engagement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a high-growth, venture-backed, or startup environment
  • Prior success influencing product roadmaps based on direct customer engagement
  • Background in data modernization, cloud adoption, and AI enablement platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to build executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders
  • Experience creating reusable frameworks, accelerators, solution templates, or developer tools
  • Open source contributions to data streaming, integration, DevOps, or distributed systems projects
  • Published technical writing, blog posts, or speaking engagements on distributed systems, data engineering, or cloud architecture
  • Track record of building SDKs, APIs, or developer tools
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Technical Impact Areas

In this role, you will work on complex, high-impact technical challenges such as:

  • Designing and implementing sub-second latency data pipelines at enterprise scale (100GB+/day throughput)
  • Building fault-tolerant, highly available distributed systems across multi-cloud environments
  • Optimizing Kubernetes clusters and containerized data workloads for cost and performance
  • Creating reusable Java/Python libraries and frameworks to accelerate customer implementations
  • Architecting real-time data solutions for digital transformation and AI enablement

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and pre-IPO stock options
  • Comprehensive health care plans (medical, dental and vision), including medical and dependent FSA
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • The chance to contribute to and shape an upbeat, fully engaged culture
  • Work with enterprise customers on transformational technical challenges
  • Significant influence on product strategy and roadmap development

Compensation

$205,000 - $220,000 USD on an annualized basis. In addition to base pay, this role offers the opportunity to earn variable-based rewards.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and accepted until the position is filled.

Our company culture fosters entrepreneurship and nurtures our team members to grow with the company. Come join a Silicon Valley startup focused on delivering a product that’s loved by its customers and primed to be a core part of the cloud data stack.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company.It is in our best interest to continue to foster an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion to bring the most value to our workforce, customers, and partners. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
raw.excerpt: Hi, we’re CompanyCam. We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries.
raw.description:
Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, self-motivated, problem-solving Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our team.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll work with a small team to build solutions in AWS that keep CompanyCam’s web and mobile applications humming. You’ll collaborate with product engineers to deploy new features and improve our existing infrastructure to make it more reliable, resilient, and secure.

You'll bring depth in one or more of the following: database operations and performance tuning, search infrastructure (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), or observability and monitoring. You'll help us scale and harden the systems that underpin CompanyCam's products as we grow.

If you have strong Infrastructure skills and experience in another area, we’d love to talk.

Working At CompanyCam

Our engineering team is remote-first, spanning every timezone across the U.S. We welcome all backgrounds and value capability over credentials; whether you have a CS degree, a high school diploma, or no diploma at all, if you’re skilled and collaborative, you’re welcome here.

We partner with product teams who work in synchronized multi-week cycles with dedicated planning phases. Our team actively collaborates with these product teams while ensuring smooth operation and continuous improvement of our production systems. We share weekly updates to track goals and maintain alignment, while giving you the flexibility to manage your work in the way that works best for you.

Meetings are purposeful and few. We champion a healthy work environment where you can focus on quality work during your 8-hour day and then log off. Nights and weekends are for you, not for work.

What We Ask Of You

Must-haves

These are our non-negotiables:

  • Show up: give us your best and have the bravery to do difficult but necessary stuff.
  • Grow up: take responsibility, learn continuously, and have a growth mindset.
  • Do good: treat your co-workers and our customers the way you want to be treated.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, including its networking, relational database management and cloud storage services.
  • Experience operating and tuning PostgreSQL or similar relational databases in production
  • Experience deploying containerized applications and working with Github Actions and Terraform.
  • Capable of scripting in bash, ruby and/or python.
  • Able to break down a complex task and document its solution
  • Understands how to analyze an existing system to identify improvements
  • Experience with AWS ECS/EKS Fargate
  • Experience operating or tuning OpenSearch/Elasticsearch clusters
  • Be technically savvy and hungry to learn.
  • Reside permanently and currently somewhere in the U.S. Alas, we're not set up to hire outside of the U.S.

Nice-to-haves

Day to day, you’ll spend most of your time designing, improving and deploying infrastructure services to AWS. You’ll be able to have even more impact if you have expertise in one or more of the following:

  • Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • PGBouncer or similar connection pooling tools
  • AWS Fargate, Aurora PostgresSQL or OpenSearch
  • Designing systems for high availability and resiliency
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to improve infrastructure or engineering workflows
  • Producing and presenting educational content of technical concepts

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried/hourly position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $185,000 -$210,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

Semrush is a brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact. We unify SEO authority and AI visibility, so brands are found, cited, and chosen everywhere search happens. That’s how Semrush gained the trust of over 28 million users—from scaling startups to Fortune 500 companies.

Some highlights of our success:

  • $470M+ Annual Recurring Revenue with AI products surpassing $38M+

  • Dollar-based net revenue retention of 104%, as of December 31, 2025

  • Large deals growing 74% YoY

  • Semrush named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Search Engine Optimization Solutions, Q3 2025

  • Exceptional demand for the Enterprise platform, with deals with global giants like JP Morgan, LG, Samsung, TikTok, and others

Shared ambition makes a bigger impact. That’s why at Semrush, progress is a partnership: You push us forward, we push you further—and we all move as one.
Are you ready to be part of this journey?

About the opportunity

The Sales team is at the forefront of empowering businesses to achieve online visibility and digital marketing success. Through our selling approach and world-class enablement programs, we equip our team with the tools, resources, and training. This is how we keep delivering meaningful results for our customers.

Joining the Sales team also means:

  • Offline and online bootcamps as part of our onboarding process

  • President’s club—an opportunity to celebrate exceptional results and reward top performers in high-class vacation destination

  • Quota attainment has been recognized as higher than market average, according to RepVue

  • Uncapped commissions

About your future tasks

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and nurture strong multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders at Fortune 500 level organizations, including marketing operations teams & senior marketing executives. Be their trusted advisor, offering strategic recommendations on how to leverage Semrush for maximum impact

  • Renewals & Retention:Own the renewal lifecycle for your portfolio, proactively managing customer health, commercial timelines, procurement requirements, and risk to drive strong retention and on-time renewals. Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and partner closely with account teams to identify expansion and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Drive Customer Value: Collaborate closely with different customer stakeholders to understand and link key workflows within their marketing operations to the business value Semrush drives. Ensure customers understand how specific features and tools directly enhance their marketing objectives and performance

  • Customer Advocacy:Act as the voice of the customer within Semrush, advocating for any improvements or enhancements based on customer needs and feedback. Stay informed about customer strategic objectives, relevant market conditions in the customers’ industry, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and threats.

  • Create & Execute Success Plans:Develop detailed, customized success plans tailored to the customer’s specific needs and business objectives. Ensure timely and efficient execution of these plans by coordinating with cross-functional teams and managing resources effectively, focusing on driving time to value and ensuring the customer sees immediate impact

  • Identify Growth Opportunities: Consistently evaluate your customer’s unique needs and identify opportunities for Semrush tools to meet them. Collaborate closely with Sales & Marketing to create expansion opportunities & product/platform upgrades

  • Product & Industry Expertise: Develop deep expertise across Semrush’s Enterprise solutions, Search, AI visibility, and the broader digital marketing landscape to provide credible strategic guidance to sophisticated enterprise customers.

  • Portfolio Management: Maintain rigorous operational discipline across your book of business, including customer health, Success Plans, renewal timelines, growth opportunities, stakeholder coverage, and forecasting. Ensure account data and next steps remain accurate and actionable.

About you

Required Qualifications:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related role, with a focus on enterprise customers, preferably in the MarTech or SaaS space

  • Proven track record of building strong relationships with different levels of seniority

  • Proven experience creating customized success plans, ensuring customers see clear connections between their processes and the results Semrush delivers

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to provide tailored solutions to meet enterprise customers’ needs

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with an ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Overall understanding of digital marketing technologies such as SEO, SEM, content marketing, analytics, CRM, and marketing automation

  • Experience with upselling customers and generating qualified leads

  • Ability to use customer data to provide insights and drive decision-making

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with BrightEdge, Conductor, SimilarWeb, or other enterprise-level marketing and SEO platforms

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity, and adapt in a rapidly changing global business environment

  • Previous experience with pipeline management in a sales or renewal context

  • You share our common values: Trust, because we prefer to speak up and be our true selves; Sense of Ownership, because it’s not worth wasting time on something you don’t believe in; and enthusiasm for Constant Changes, because we are always looking to make things better

About the perks

  • Strong product-market fit recognized by RepVue

  • High earning potential with clear quota attainment visibility

  • Employee Support Program

  • Loss of family member financial aid

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Hobby & team building budget allowance

A little more about the company

Semrush is the leading brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact.

Built on the industry’s most expansive proprietary dataset, Semrush delivers AI-driven insights across GEO, SEO, Agentic Search Optimization, content marketing, paid media, and social strategy. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Boston, MA with a global presence across North America, Europe and Asia.

We’ve built something people are proud to be part of. And the awards agree: Great Place to Work, DEI Workplace, Diversity Champion Award, International Inclusion Award, Most Women Friendly Employers, Best Place for Working Parents. All thanks to 1700+ employees who build the company every day.

About our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion commitments

Semrush is an equal opportunity employer. Building a better future for marketers around the world unites people from all backgrounds. Even if you feel that you don’t 100% match all requirements, don’t be discouraged to apply! We are committed to ensure that everyone feels a sense of belonging in the workplace.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or medical condition including medical characteristics, genetic identity, marital status, military service, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

We don’t just lead the market—we are busy creating a world where Semrush is an unfair advantage for every marketer. Join us!

raw.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Bullhorn, you'll be building the tools and systems that facilitate large-scale software releases safely and effectively. This includes all pipelines for building, packaging, deploying, and validating software delivery. You will help the team take code changes safely and quickly from a developer's machine all the way to production. We're a release-engineering and platform team: we build and maintain the systems that enable engineering teams to deploy with confidence. We relentlessly automate manual toil from the software delivery lifecycle.

This is a hands-on building role. You'll write automations, own our deploy and CI/CD tooling, containerize and modernize our environments, and partner directly with engineering teams to remove the friction that slows them down.

A Typical Day Will Include...

  • Designing, building, and maintaining deploy and release pipelines, and the automation that reduces manual intervention during releases

  • Building and improving our internal release tooling — for example, automating script packaging and DBA approvals, code + script deploys, and release-finishing workflows

  • Advancing our CI/CD GitOps process: authoring reusable GitLab CI templates, Helm charts, and ArgoCD applications so teams can self-serve their own build and deploy pipelines

  • Containerizing and modernizing our QA and lower environments (Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible) to bring them closer to production parity

  • Modernizing build tools across the org to ensure we’re using the latest and greatest technology across all teams.

  • Attending daily team stand-ups and collaborating with a distributed, cross-functional team across US and UK time zones

  • Troubleshooting deployment and infrastructure issues, and partnering with engineering teams to resolve environment-specific problems

  • Leveraging AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and similar) as a core part of how you work — writing unit tests and automation, accelerating investigation and refactoring, and finding new ways to eliminate toil

  • Writing clean, well-tested automation and scripts (Python, Bash) and following solid engineering practices for the tools we own

  • Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and developer enablement so knowledge is shared and not siloed

  • Mentoring teammates, driving conversations about priorities and process, and independently owning complex, cross-cutting initiatives

  • Working within a positive, energizing, collaborative team environment

This Role Is a Fit for You If...

  • You want to be an integral part of an innovative, high-performance engineering team

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with frequent software releases

  • You're an automation-first thinker — if you do something more than twice, your instinct is to automate it

  • You can work through complex problems independently while knowing when to pull others in and help less experienced teammates do the same

  • You're comfortable scripting and building tooling in Python and Bash/shell

  • You have hands-on experience with CI/CD systems — GitLab CI/CD and/or Jenkins — including building and maintaining pipelines

  • You're experienced with containers and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm

  • You're comfortable building full-stack automation tooling — scripting and backend work in Python, and frontend/UI work in JavaScript (our internal tools have both a Python backend and a web frontend)

  • You've worked with GitOps and/or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (ArgoCD, Ansible, or similar)

  • You're comfortable with Git-based workflows and modern versioning practices

  • You see AI tooling as a force multiplier and are eager to use it to raise your own and the team's output

  • You care about reliability, security, and developer experience, and you communicate clearly with the engineering teams you support

  • You're comfortable challenging and being challenged by your teammates

Bonus Points...

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or relevant work experience

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS), including services like RDS

  • Experience with deployment tooling such as Octopus Deploy, and with artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory)

  • Experience with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Backstage, Rancher, or ELK)

  • Familiarity with SQL Server and collaborating with DBA teams on script and schema deployments

  • Exposure to secure SDLC / compliance considerations (SOC), and building change management into pipelines

  • Experience modernizing or migrating legacy systems (e.g., ColdFusion, legacy build jobs) toward modern, containerized workflows

  • Comfort working across geographically distributed teams and time zones

The annual base salary range for this position is $105,000 - $115,000. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus & a comprehensive benefits package.

Compensation and Transparency Statement

The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.

What we offer...

  • Benefits eligibility effective DAY ONE including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), 401(k) Match, and more

  • Unlimited Planned Paid Time Off

  • Global Mental Health Support

  • On-Demand Learning & Development

  • Quarterly paid volunteer days

  • Lucrative Employee Referral Program (eligible for prior to your first day)

  • Company-wide mentor program

Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

We are a people-first culture where everyone’s contribution is valued and respected. We're looking for smart, forward-thinking individuals who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. If you're someone who thrives in a casual, yet fast-paced and agile environment, we'd love to have you join us.

Summary:

The Principal Technology Engineer provides enterprise-wide technical leadership and strategic direction for technology engineering initiatives. You’ll guide modernization efforts, establish engineering best practices, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term business strategy. This role influences architectural standards and drives innovation across multiple systems and services.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership for enterprise technology strategy, governance, and architecture alignment for the organization's Data Center networking environment.
  • Lead the design, engineering, implementation, and modernization of enterprise Data Center network solutions supporting mission-critical business services.
  • Define engineering standards, reference architectures, operational frameworks, and automation practices to improve operational efficiency, resiliency, scalability, and security.

🇨🇦 Up to CAD 65,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract
🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Canada!

🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment
💻 High-end, fast computer
💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need

About the Role

We are hiring a Client Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day social operations of a major US entertainment client.

Reporting to the Account Manager on the account, you will coordinate the operating rhythm behind the work: content approvals, stakeholder follow-up, meeting preparation, campaign project management, file organisation, episode deliveries, social-account access, and cross-workstream status visibility.

This is not passive administration. The role is about making complex work visible, organised, and dependable. You will know what is moving, what is waiting for approval, who owns the next step, where the latest file lives, and when a blocker needs to be escalated.

You will work across a high volume of moving parts and stakeholders, helping Storm and the client stay aligned as content, campaigns, meetings, approvals, assets, and access requirements move forward.

A significant part of the role is follow-through. You will be expected to chase inputs, maintain accurate trackers, capture decisions clearly, surface risks early, and make sure agreed actions actually happen.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-moving work involving lots of people, deadlines, systems, and dependencies, this role will suit you well.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, an international team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working.

We use modern technology, including carefully selected AI-assisted tools, to create clearer workflows, make better decisions, catch problems earlier, and deliver consistently high-quality work.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinate high-volume social-content approvals, feedback, revisions, deadlines, and final sign-off across Storm and client stakeholders
  • Prepare for recurring meetings, capture decisions and actions, and make sure follow-ups are completed
  • Project-manage smaller social campaigns, maintaining clear timelines, owners, dependencies, approvals, assets, and risks
  • Keep client files, episode deliveries, social-account access, permissions, and related operational processes organised and up to date
  • Maintain shared trackers, calendars, and documentation so priorities, deadlines, blockers, and responsibilities remain visible
  • Chase inputs, surface risks early, escalate blockers appropriately, and keep work moving across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Keep operational processes, templates, contacts, and handover information current so work is reliable and repeatable

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience supporting client operations, social-content workflows, project delivery, account teams, or another fast-moving environment involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and approval routes
  • Strong organisation across multiple workstreams, deadlines, approval paths, versions, and dependencies
  • High ownership and a proactive approach to keeping work moving
  • Clear written communication and the ability to turn scattered feedback or ambiguous requests into concise actions, owners, and decisions
  • Experience preparing for recurring meetings, producing useful recaps, and following actions through to completion
  • Confidence coordinating high-volume approval workflows involving internal teams, senior stakeholders, legal review, or multiple revision rounds
  • Practical experience with file-management and project-management systems such as Box, Monday.com, Airtable, spreadsheets, or comparable tools
  • Good judgement about when to follow up, when to challenge, when to escalate, and when a decision sits outside your authority
  • A calm and dependable approach when work is late, unclear, blocked, or changing quickly
  • Confidence using modern productivity tools, including AI-assisted tools where appropriate, to prepare, organise, check, and follow through on work
  • Good judgement around checking AI-assisted outputs and handling confidential information carefully

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvals move through the correct stakeholders with accurate statuses, complete feedback, and no lost decisions
  • Meetings are properly prepared, decisions are clearly documented, actions have owners, and follow-up happens without repeated prompting
  • Campaign teams can quickly see the latest milestones, assets, versions, risks, approvals, and delivery status
  • Client and agency teams trust the operational picture because updates are clear, details are accurate, and blockers are raised early
  • Episode deliveries, files, account access, and recurring operational tasks are organised and dependable
  • Important context carries cleanly between Storm and client meetings rather than being lost between teams
  • Scope changes are made visible and discussed rather than quietly absorbed into the role
  • You do not wait for someone else to notice that something is slipping; you identify it, make it visible, and help drive it towards resolution

This Role Will Suit You If

  • You enjoy the operational side of social and campaign work: coordination, approvals, meetings, systems, timing, and follow-through
  • You like bringing order to work that spans many people, tools, and deadlines
  • You are naturally good at keeping track of details without losing sight of the bigger picture
  • You communicate warmly and clearly while still being willing to chase, challenge, and escalate
  • You like being the person who knows where things stand and what needs to happen next
  • You are comfortable working independently within clear boundaries and asking precise questions when authority or scope is unclear
  • You take satisfaction from making complicated workflows more reliable and easier for other people to work within

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
We use modern collaboration, file-management, project-management, social-platform, password-management, and AI-enabled workflow tools to support our teams and clients.

Agility and Openness for Ideas
We actively encourage people to improve how work is organised and delivered. Operating with the agility of a growing company alongside the support of an established organisation means we value practical ideas, quick problem-solving, and strong follow-through.

Team-based
This is a dedicated, embedded role working closely with both Storm Ideas and client stakeholders. You will work with the Account Manager, strategy leads, production teams, and other client and agency stakeholders, with clear escalation routes for decisions and approvals.

Flexibility
Storm is a remote-first company. This particular role requires consistent working hours aligned to Pacific Time, currently expected to be approximately 9:00am–5:30pm PT, Monday to Friday.

Recruitment Process

Online video interview with short recorded answers to role-relevant questions.

First interview with Account Management leadership or the recruitment team

Practical exercise based on realistic operational inputs, asking you to produce a prioritised action plan and client update and explain how you used and checked the tools that supported your work, including AI where relevant
Second interview and exercise review with a senior leader

And that's it!

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $150/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

• Own product launches and go-to-market programs from strategy through execution, partnering closely with Product and commercial teams to bring new capabilities to market quickly and effectively.
• Develop differentiated competitive positioning and market intelligence that helps Revaly sharpen its strategy, messaging, and commercial approach.
• Lead the overall demand generation strategy, providing direction and oversight to scale integrated programs across digital, content, email, SDR, field marketing, and owned channels that convert market awareness into qualified pipeline.
• Partner closely with Sales to develop enablement materials, talk tracks, battle cards, customer stories, and outbound assets that make Revaly’s value easier to understand and sell.
• Lead Revaly’s content and executive thought leadership strategy, turning product expertise, customer insights, payments data, and market trends into compelling market-facing narratives.
• Drive co-marketing programs with strategic partners, platforms, issuers, and channel relationships, ensuring consistent positioning and coordinated execution.
• Lead field marketing initiatives including conferences, webinars, roundtables, customer events, and executive engagement programs.
• Establish marketing KPIs, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms tied to engagement, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact.
• Build scalable marketing systems, processes, automation workflows, and AI-enabled ways of working that increase the team’s speed and effectiveness.
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of marketing specialists, creating clear priorities and a high bar for strategic thinking, creativity, accountability, and execution.
• Serve as Marketing’s strategic voice across Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership, contributing to company planning and shaping Revaly’s broader go-to-market roadmap.

What You Bring

• 5–7+ years of product marketing experience, ideally within payments, fintech, payment infrastructure, or another complex B2B technology environment.
• Strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, with the ability to understand merchant and issuer needs, payment approval challenges, and the technology that connects them.
• A track record of translating complex technical products into clear positioning, differentiated messaging, compelling customer value propositions, and effective go-to-market programs.
• Experience owning product marketing across launches, market and customer research, competitive intelligence, positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and adoption.
• Experience building or shaping an emerging market category, including developing the narrative and education required to create market understanding and demand.
• Experience leading and developing a team of marketing specialists, with the ability to set strategy while staying close enough to execution to move work forward.
• Demonstrated experience building integrated B2B demand generation programs and connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
• Strong analytical capabilities and experience establishing marketing KPIs, funnel reporting, attribution, and performance measurement.
• Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and executive teams on go-to-market strategy and execution.
• Familiarity or curiosity with AI-powered productivity tools.
• A calm, confident communicator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.

What Success Looks Like

• Within the first 6 months, Revaly has a sharper, differentiated category and product narrative that clearly communicates Payment Performance Management, and Revaly’s value across priority audiences.
• Within the first 6 months, repeatable product marketing processes are in place for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and cross-functional go-to-market planning.
• Within 6–9 months, integrated marketing programs are generating measurable qualified pipeline, with clear funnel reporting and visibility into marketing’s contribution to revenue.
• Within 6–9 months, Sales and partner-facing teams have a consistent set of messaging, enablement tools, customer stories, and competitive resources that improve confidence and effectiveness in market conversations.
• Within the first 12 months, Revaly has measurably increased awareness and understanding of the Payment Performance Management category among priority buyers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
• Within the first 12 months, Revaly has a scalable marketing operating system with clear KPIs, reporting, processes, ownership, and a high-performing team capable of supporting the company’s next stage of growth.

Why Revaly

We’re a growing global company committed to building a team filled with diverse cultures, viewpoints, and experiences. As they say, variety is the spice of life. No matter how large we become, we will always be connected through our shared sense of community and slightly quirky personalities.

Our vibrant culture is filled with talented, creative, deeply curious, high achievers. We believe in and invest in our people because we know they are the secret to our success. We are happy to extend the following benefits to our employees:

  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • Comprehensive health benefits package effective from day one

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here’s what you can expect if you apply:

Step 1 — Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes)
If your experience looks like a fit, you’ll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat. It’s a two-way conversation, we’ll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you’ll have space to ask about Revaly, our mission, and what it’s like to work here. It’s also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2 — Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes)
Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We’ll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You’ll also get a clearer picture of the team’s goals and priorities.

Step 3 — Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes)
In this stage, you’ll meet with someone from the team you’ll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you’ll be building alongside.

Step 4 — 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes)
In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they’d aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish. This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we’re operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.
If you’ve applied for a role in Technology or Product Development, you can also expect a skill-based assessment between step 3 and 4, to help us assess some key role-based requirements.

Our Business

FISPAN Services Inc. (FISPAN) is an Enterprise SaaS FinTech company that allows banks to deploy embedded financial products and services to create a seamless banking connection for their corporate clients. Our product aims to provide instant scale and reach for banks who want to remove friction and add value by enabling their commercial banking clients to access banking services through their preferred ERP / accounting platform.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in downtown Vancouver, FISPAN is on a mission to create the best product in the FinTech industry and fundamentally change the way that companies bank. Being the market leader in ERP Banking, we work with the world’s Tier 1 banks with assets exceeding $3T, including J.P. Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo, TD and Bank of Montreal.

We are looking for dynamic and passionate individuals to join our high performance team and contribute to our rapid growth and exciting journey.

Job Overview

The Strategic Partner Manager (IC4) represents the highest individual contributor level in the organization. You are the undisputed "CEO" of FISPAN's largest and most strategic bank partnerships. You combine executive-level strategic vision with deep tactical knowledge to drive massive user growth, market expansion, and C-suite alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Undisputed Account CEO: Own total strategic and commercial accountability for multi-million-dollar banking portfolios. Proactively identify, negotiate, and close complex, multi-year expansion deals.

SAP Data Conversion Consultant- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Data Conversion Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Conversion Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Network Partnerships team sits within the Partnerships organization and is a key component of Stripe's success. Our team is responsible for developing and managing relationships with critical partners, such as Visa, Mastercard, and American Express, which are fundamental to the success of Stripe's product strategy and delivering new capabilities to Stripe users.

What you'll do

We're looking for a US or Canada-based candidate to join our team to lead one of Stripe's critical network partnerships. The candidate will manage overall partner health, build internal strategy and business cases, drive deal negotiation and execution, and coordinate priorities with internal teams and external partners. The role requires close coordination with leadership, product and engineering teams, as well as cross-functional stakeholders including Legal, Finance, Risk, etc., and with external partners' leaders and senior executives.

  • Use data to drive strategy and decisions • Coordinate with internal cross-functional stakeholders (including risk, compliance, product, engineering, treasury, and global partner managers) to drive creation and execution of partner strategy

  • Juggle and reconcile competing priorities to drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal across multiple stakeholders

Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Risk Operations is responsible for managing the risk relationships spanning across global payment method, card, and financial partners. It's our mission to build operational controls to mitigate user and partner risk and enable strategic development opportunities.

What you'll do

As a Risk Operations Analyst, you'll work to ensure our policies, operations, and workflows align to the needs of our financial partners. You'll be accountable for workflows impacting a variety of cross-functional internal and external stakeholders to identify and assess regulatory, contractual, and partner risk. Further, you'll influence and advise operational teams in building out scalable operational processes to ensure compliance with service level agreements, routine reporting, and overall risk mitigation.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate merchants, from successful venture-backed startups to well-established institutions by assessing suitability to process on Stripe

  • Contribute to projects to enhance and optimize due diligence strategy systems and tools
  • Help build and scale processes across the risk operations ecosystem
  • Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies, and recommend enhancements and process improvements to mitigate emerging risks through a collaborative approach with stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, or operations in a fast-moving environment
  • Experience scaling operational processes and driving quantifiable improvements
  • Experience working cross-functionally on complex problems
  • Ability to use data to quantify problems, tell a story, and influence a solution
  • The ability and desire to challenge the status quo
  • Creative thinker who considers problems from a customer perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented when solving them
  • Experience analyzing feedback patterns and using those insights to drive process and tooling improvements
  • You have a lot of ownership, are accountable, and drive towards ambitious goals.
  • Deep empathy for entrepreneurs running a business and motivation to solve problems to empower them

Preferred qualifications

Our customers include some of the most iconic QSR and fast-casual brands across 23,000+ locations worldwide.

About the role

We're seeking a Growth Marketing Lead to build and lead Momos' growth marketing function, turning growth marketing into a measurable, scalable revenue engine.

You'll own full-funnel acquisition and pipeline growth across paid, SEO/SEM, lifecycle, ABM, and other high-impact channels — running structured experiments, building the measurement framework, and translating results into scalable programs that show what's actually driving pipeline and revenue.

This role also leads our existing growth marketing team in SEA, and works closely with senior leadership to connect growth activity to broader business strategy — turning experiments, market trends, and results into a clear narrative on what's working and where to invest next.

The ideal candidate is analytical and commercially minded, strategic and hands-on — equally comfortable in funnel analysis, team coaching, and executive storytelling.

Key Responsibilities

Build the Growth Engine

  • Own full-funnel growth strategy — acquisition, activation, conversion, revenue — across paid, SEO/SEM, lifecycle, and ABM.
  • Establish the growth operating model: KPIs, reporting, experimentation frameworks, attribution, performance cadence.
  • Run structured experiments across channels, offers, messaging, and journeys; kill what fails, scale what works.
  • Build growth metrics infrastructure (funnel tracking, attribution, CAC/LTV, pipeline velocity, ROI) with RevOps/Data.
  • Maintain a clear view of which activities drive pipeline/revenue and where to invest next.

Lead & Develop the Team

  • Lead the existing growth team — set ownership, priorities, and performance standards.
  • Coach team members into strategic marketers, not just executors.
  • Build a high-accountability, experimentation-driven culture.
  • Identify capability gaps and scale team/process/vendor resources as needed.
  • Manage external vendors and agencies across paid, lifecycle, and SEO/SEM.

Partner With Sales, Product & Leadership

  • Run ABM programs with Sales and Product Marketing against key accounts, with clear conversion targets.
  • Align growth programs with Sales, Product, Data, and RevOps on commercial objectives.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to leadership on growth strategy and customer insights.
  • Turn data into a clear, compelling business narrative for leadership.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining alignment and execution.

Own Performance & Commercial Impact

  • Own performance reporting — ROI, CAC, lead quality, conversion, pipeline velocity, revenue contribution — as the core output of the role.
  • Maintain a live optimization backlog focused on highest-impact opportunities.
  • Show a clear, measurable link between growth spend and revenue.
  • Represent growth at a small number of high-leverage field events/conferences annually, with logistics handled by coordinators or vendors.

Requirements

  • 5–8+ years in growth, demand gen, or full-funnel marketing at fast-growing SaaS/tech companies, including experience building or scaling a growth function, team, or operating model.
  • Demonstrated ownership of funnel economics (CAC, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, LTV, ROI, revenue contribution) and a track record running structured experiments with a test-learn-kill-scale mindset.
  • Experience across paid, SEO/SEM, lifecycle, and ABM, with strong commercial judgment to separate activity from real impact; field marketing is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Experience managing and developing marketing talent, comfortable partnering with senior, opinionated stakeholders.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, plus strong project management and cross-functional alignment.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity across Pacific and SEA time zones, with occasional travel for select field events. Vertical SaaS experience (hospitality tech, customer engagement platforms) preferred.

Benefits

Why Join Momos?

  • Mission-driven, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • Collaborative, flat company culture
  • Comprehensive private health insurance
  • Discretionary trips to our offices worldwide, with global travel medical coverage
  • Cross-cultural team bonding and networking

Equal Opportunity

Momos is an equal-opportunity workplace that embraces diversity and different cultures. We started as an international company and know that building an organization with diverse experiences, perspectives, and opinions allows our team to grow and excel.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Roots is a wealth-building platform built on a simple belief: everyone deserves a real path to financial growth, and that path should feel achievable.

We create simple, accessible ways for people to participate in ownership and invest in real assets, making wealth-building more engaging and within reach. Today, Roots is a growing ecosystem that combines an investment platform, financial tools, and education to support long-term financial progress.

We’re already helping a rapidly growing community take meaningful steps toward building wealth, and we’ve seen that when the experience feels intuitive and rewarding, people actually stick with it. That’s what we’re continuing to build.

Why We Need You

As our real estate portfolio has grown to more than 1,500 single-family rental homes across multiple states, we’re building a finance function that reflects the complexity of owning and operating institutional-quality real estate.

This is a new role on our Finance team that will work day-to-day alongside our President of Real Estate, helping bridge finance and operations as we continue to scale. While you’ll report through Finance, you’ll become the primary accounting partner supporting our real estate portfolio.

You’ll own the financial reporting and portfolio accounting for our REIT, sitting at the intersection of property-level accounting and portfolio-level financial reporting. Working closely with third-party property management companies, you’ll ensure accurate, timely, and well-organized financial data that supports internal decision-making, investor reporting, and the continued growth of our portfolio.

This is a highly operational role for someone who enjoys owning monthly close processes, reconciling data from multiple sources, and transforming property management data into clean, standardized financial reporting. You’ll primarily support management accounting and internal reporting while ensuring our books and financial statements remain GAAP compliant.

Role Responsibilities

  • Maintain monthly portfolio schedules, including acquisitions, dispositions, and portfolio changes across our single-family rental portfolio.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records at both the property and portfolio levels.
  • Record and track annual replacement reserves and other portfolio-level adjustments.
  • Serve as the primary accounting contact for third-party property management companies.
  • Collect, review, and reconcile monthly financial information, including rent rolls, income statements, trial balances, invoices, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up with variance analysis on discrepancies, missing information, and reporting delays to keep month-end close on schedule.
  • Prepare monthly portfolio reporting and consolidated financial statements for internal leadership.
  • Support investor reporting, Regulation A reporting requirements, audits, tax preparation, and other financial reporting needs.
  • Partner closely with the President of Real Estate, acquisitions, and finance teams to ensure portfolio activity is accurately reflected in financial reporting.
  • Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules during month-end close.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, internal controls, and automation as we continue to scale.
  • Perform ad hoc financial analyses and reporting to support operational and investment decisions.
  • Own the accuracy and integrity of portfolio financial data, proactively identifying issues and driving them to resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of accounting experience, preferably within real estate, property management, fund accounting, or a REIT.
  • Strong understanding of property accounting principles and month-end close processes.
  • Experience reconciling and consolidating financial information from multiple external sources.
  • Experience working with residential real estate portfolios, preferably single-family rentals.
  • Familiarity with REIT accounting and financial reporting is preferred.
  • Experience with Yardi, AppFolio, Sage, or similar accounting software is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and financial analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring monthly deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Highly analytical with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve.
  • Excited to build new processes and help establish a scalable real estate accounting function.

How We Work

Our values show up in how we work: we take ownership, stay curious, communicate clearly, use resources wisely, treat people fairly, and aren’t afraid to challenge how things have always been done.


At Roots, we're committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We firmly believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation, enhancing the quality of our work and the strength of our team. Join us and be part of an inclusive environment where every perspective is valued.
